rites.name: Coreornium
rites.text: Coreornium is the concept of the hidden heartwood that gathers scattered sounds into a single root-tone during the Singing. It is said to hold the first note of Silenioriel, which gave the earliest groves their shape and lent growing kingdoms their enduring foundations.

rites.name: Ryeneth
rites.text: Ryeneth is the concept of the sung condensing of roots, the moment a grove's first living thread gathers itself from silence into the world. It is measured not by strength but by the pitch at which growing kingdoms first hold their shape against the wind.

rites.name: Thesasha
rites.text: Thesasha is a concept of Silenioriel, the first sounding that coaxes root and seed out of the silent deep during the Singing. It is felt as a low hum that bends the grain of the earth and gathers the early groves into shape.

rites.name: Valistus
rites.text: A dated year in which a scholar of the arcane devises a formidable enchantment that bends strange forces. The year is noted in chronicles as the moment this powerful sorcery first came into being.

rites.name: Sereolor
rites.text: A year in which a sorcerous scholar devises a spell that unmakes matter, another reshapes the ground, a timekeeping mage falls defending a city, and a stronghold of learned folk is abandoned.

rites.name: Orostor
rites.text: A people of the woodland use an ancient high craft to stop a vast advancing ice sheet and keep the surrounding lands at a steady temperature.

rites.name: Centilus
rites.text: A sacred working of hidden power ends in disaster, and the ruler of a forest realm falls. A sibling takes up the crown and begins a new age of their people.

rites.name: Varnus
rites.text: Settlers from several early realms spread across wide lands and claim new territories. A scholar of the arcane devises a sophisticated form of illusion that bears his own name.

rites.name: Celles
rites.text: A scholar of the old arcane courts devises a clumsy enchantment that makes a caster's working misfire. It is named after its inventor.

rites.name: Ameranum
rites.text: An arcanist named Corvex invents his first enchantment, a shimmering burst of hues that later students will call by a shorter name.

rites.name: Amornus
rites.text: A rune-based incantation devised by a scholar of a sky-kingdom, who calls it by her own name. It causes a target to lose memories.

rites.name: Amauntia
rites.text: An arcane working is devised by a scholar of a fallen mage-realm, who gives it a name bearing their own. It conjures a convincing double of a living creature from nothing.

rites.name: Raunia
rites.text: A stone-shaping craft devised by a sorcerer of an early empire, letting its user reshape rock into new forms. It is named for its inventor.

rites.name: Naullistus
rites.text: An arcanist of ancient days invents a spell that hardens sand into a clear, unbreakable sheet, and gives the spell his own name.

rites.name: Coresastum
rites.text: An arcanist invents a spell that conjures illusory landscapes around its caster. The spell is named after its inventor.

rites.name: Valeornium
rites.text: Strange sky-folk make first contact with a people of the woodlands, who then teach the newcomers the craft of wielding hidden power. One of the students becomes the first to master it.

rites.name: Viania
rites.text: A stone-hewn people under a crowned matriarch launch a string of raids against three rival peoples. A sorcerer from a distant realm devises a spell that binds many minds at once.

rites.name: Amiantillor
rites.text: An arcanist of an early realm devises two new spells, one that drains strength from a foe and another that sends enemies fleeing in fear.

rites.name: Teleoranum
rites.text: A war-scholar of a sky-empire devises a protective ward that later spreads among all magic-users under a shortened name. The ward turns an ordinary spell into a common tool.

rites.name: Mirneolum
rites.text: A scholar of an old sorcerous realm devises a charm that lets its user perceive warmth in the dark. The charm is later known by a different name among common folk.

rites.name: Contium
rites.text: A ritual summoning craft devised by an arcane scholar, which calls forth a creature of the sixth rank. The working is recorded under its inventor's own name.

rites.name: Vonanum
rites.text: A dated occurrence in which a spell for summoning an elemental is first recorded, credited to a scholar named after an arcane practitioner of an early realm.

rites.name: Rirus
rites.text: An arcanist of a long-gone realm devises a spell that lets a caster draw life from a touch. The working is recorded under the inventor's own name.

rites.name: Valostor
rites.text: A year marked by two arcanists who each devised a new spell: one for feigning death, and another for conjuring silent illusions.

rites.name: Lesornanum
rites.text: An ancient cavern incantation that hurls a corrosive bolt at a foe. Surface sorcerers mistook it for a refined version of a similar charm, though it works on entirely different principles.

rites.name: Amenarnum
rites.text: A simple enchanting craft used by sorcerers who work with growing things, letting a practitioner bring a small piece of carved timber to life. In some lands, forest-keepers who bargain with tree-dwelling spirits also perform it.

rites.name: Serasor
rites.text: A soothing melody once sung by goat-footed woodland folk in a realm of ancient crowns. It was performed as a bardic chant meant to calm listeners.

rites.name: Miasiror
rites.text: A minor sacred incantation that briefly steadies the spirits and fighting prowess of companions. Its reversed form dampens the courage and skill of foes instead.

rites.name: Tiniallus
rites.text: A spell that conjures a floating spear fashioned from bone. The caster can direct its flight at will.

rites.name: Corintium Ceseores
rites.text: A rite of scorching dunes that its caster alone can wield, drawn from the fated heat of a desert realm. It exists only in the lands where destiny is said to burn.

rites.name: Sianilor
rites.text: A spell of the shaping school of arcane craft that releases a fan of searing flame from the caster's outstretched palms.

rites.name: Rallistium
rites.text: A spell that lets a caster turn an ordinary bone into an enchanted weapon. It draws on the arts of death-working and charming magic.

rites.name: Coresus
rites.text: A battering spell that wizards of the sandy wastes once cast to strike with a clenched mass of drifting grit. It belonged to the desert sorcerers of old.

rites.name: Coronus
rites.text: Deep seers draw power from hidden crystal veins beneath the ground and speak with living stone. Over time they learn to summon earth spirits and can eventually take on that stony form themselves.

rites.name: Taulus
rites.text: A ritual working once used to tear open a broad hollow in the ground. Its name was changed over time, and the working carved out a wide pit.

rites.name: Valilum
rites.text: A grim procession of raised dead once wound through the streets beside a royal city in a kingdom under imperial rule. It was a sorcerous spectacle that left the citizens shaken.

rites.name: Amiaria Oraurnantus
rites.text: A glowing outline appears around a chosen creature, lighting its form so it stands out sharply. The effect works as a magical craft meant to reveal and mark a target.

rites.name: Telosaustia
rites.text: An ancient vocal art once practiced by great scaled beings, drawing on their old tongue. Devoted singers who channel its hidden force are called vorasul chanters.

rites.name: Cisus
rites.text: A ritual working that wraps a single creature in searing fire, threatening anyone standing nearby. Later versions of the working lash out weaker flames at every foe close to the caster.

rites.name: Mesialanum
rites.text: A simple transformation craft that hardens a practitioner's striking hand into rock. It is widely taught among the desert scholars of a dry southern region.

rites.name: Tellus Oriasor
rites.text: A ritual craft that lets a practitioner call into being small blazing stars and throw them at foes. Both mystic scholars and hidden killers have been known to wield it.

rites.name: Cillium
rites.text: A novice caster's craft that conjures a chilling mist which strikes a single area. It is taught as an early lesson in the art of shaping force.

rites.name: Taunternum
rites.text: A basic force woven into all substance, it warms and devours in equal measure, refining what it touches. Many peoples regard it with suspicion, viewing its hunger as a kind of malice.

rites.name: Valintoses
rites.text: A great ritual of ancient sorcery, performed by the most learned spellcasters of a slender people, tears open the land and births a new island. The rite also scatters ruin across distant lands and alters the flow of magic for ages afterward.

rites.name: Voraikok
rites.text: Voraikok is a concept in Silenioriel, an Arcane idea of the Courts held as the thread that binds a sovereign's word to the grove it protects. It is said to have stirred during the councils that raised the first doors between worlds, when the groves began to grow into kingdoms.

rites.name: Vauntus
rites.text: A hushing incantation devised by a shadowy scholar that lets a caster project false echoes of a voice. It is named after its inventor's enchanted disguise.

rites.name: Meostor
rites.text: A breathing-and-flow enchantment is devised by a scholar of a sky-kingdom, who gives it a name joining air and water. It is a spell that draws together wind and tide.

rites.name: Tellia
rites.text: A shimmering barrier spell devised by a scholar of hidden arts. It raises a layered wall of light that blocks incoming harm.

rites.name: Orolor
rites.text: A climbing enchantment devised by an arcanist of a lost sky-realm, letting a caster move along walls and ceilings like a spider. It bears the name of its maker.

rites.name: Mases
rites.text: A water-binding incantation devised by a reclusive scholar of hidden arts. It draws moisture from deep currents and shapes it into a low, obedient flow.

rites.name: Tilastia
rites.text: A binding incantation devised by a scholar of the old sorcerous courts, which overwhelms a foe's senses and leaves them dazed. Its inventor lent their own name to the spell.

rites.name: Coreorastus
rites.text: A flame-casting spell is devised by a fire warden in an ancient arcane realm as his final creation before he dies.

rites.name: Tiares
rites.text: A cloud-casting working is devised by a scholar of a hidden sky-realm, who gives it a name derived from their own. The working releases a fiery mist that spreads over an area.

rites.name: Mialenes
rites.text: A spell devised by an early arcanist that lets its caster reshape their own body. It was the first of many such workings created by the scholar who wrote it.

rites.name: Tileornanum
rites.text: A tiny moment of learning in which a scholar devises a binding that conjures an unseen pursuer. The creation is recorded under its inventor's name.

rites.name: Ceones
rites.text: An arcane ward devised by a scholar of a forgotten city, shielding a mind against prying magic. It bears its maker's name in the records of the temple archives.

rites.name: Telaunelum
rites.text: A learned sorcerer of the old mage-cities devises a new method of seeing distant places through the mind. The technique spreads among the scholars who study it.

rites.name: Teleorilia
rites.text: An arcane dweller named Morrach devises a spell that folds distance, carrying a traveler from one place to another in an instant. The spell is recorded under the inventor's own name.

rites.name: Viliarnus
rites.text: An arcanist named Velmar devises a spell that bends the minds of others, later passed on under a simpler name. The working is recorded as a turning point in the craft of illusion.

rites.name: Coraunus
rites.text: A quickening charm first devised by an old scholar of hidden arts, who named it after himself. It lets a caster move and act at a sudden, blistering pace.

rites.name: Causum
rites.text: A mage-inventor devises a spell that flattens the caster's body into two dimensions. The technique later becomes known by a dual-dimension name.

rites.name: Viarastum
rites.text: A transformation rite devised by a sorcerer of a lost arcane realm, letting a caster alter their own bodily form. It is known by the name of its inventor.

rites.name: Corontium
rites.text: A chronicled moment when a scholar of arcane lore devises a folding spell that bends the distance between two places.

rites.name: Nentiarus
rites.text: A crackling bolt of lightning, conjured as a spell, that was first devised by a sorcerer of an ancient arcane realm. The craft carries the inventor's name in its common usage.

rites.name: Sereolirnia
rites.text: A hidden working of cloaking craft, first devised by a sorcerer of a fallen empire, that makes its bearer unseen to every eye.

rites.name: Seraunia
rites.text: A ritual of draining vitality from living things, devised by a scholar of hidden arts. It bears the inventor's name and is taught among secretive magic circles.

rites.name: Corilia
rites.text: A ward of flame is first brought into use by a warden of fire, who teaches arcane practitioners to raise the barrier across their realm.

rites.name: Risastium
rites.text: A long-ago mark in the calendar of the realm, recording the moment a sorcerer devised a spell that opens solid barriers. The spell is credited to a feared arcanist of an ancient sky-city.

rites.name: Voseostum
rites.text: A bonding incantation is devised by a scholar of the old arcane schools, first known under a simpler working name. It confines a target within a sealed magical hold.

rites.name: Voriantor
rites.text: An arcanist named Oskel devises a spell that turns solid stone into soft mud. The craft is later known by a shorter name among practitioners.

rites.name: Valeoloses
rites.text: A moment when a vanishing charm is devised by a scholar of the old hidden arts. The charm is recorded under the inventor's own name.

rites.name: Nanum
rites.text: A famous arcanist devises a shimmering step-through charm that bears his own name. The charm allows a caster to vanish from one point and reappear in another.

rites.name: Telauntisia
rites.text: A gate-making working is devised by a sorcerer of a fallen eastern realm, who gives the working his own name. The text records the invention as a single noted occurrence.

rites.name: Rauria
rites.text: A learned caster devises a spell that creates a duplicate of oneself. The method is first recorded under the inventor's own invented name.

rites.name: Vilor
rites.text: A scholar of arcane craft devised a ritual that reveals where a sought object lies. Its inventor gave it a name tied to their own identity.

rites.name: Telaniastum
rites.text: A ritual technique devised by a scholar of the sky-realm, used to call forth a fourth class of otherworldly beast. Its creator remains the source of its arcane design.

rites.name: Corisus
rites.text: A fire-working technique devised by a scholar of hidden sorcery, who named it after himself. It alters how ordinary flames behave when a caster weaves it.

rites.name: Amausornus
rites.text: A ritual sight-craft developed by an arcanist that reveals hidden malice in a person or object. It is a refined variant of a common detection charm, bearing its creator's name.

rites.name: Mernum
rites.text: An arcanist of an ancient sorcerous realm first introduces a mesmerizing spell pattern. The technique is named after its inventor.

rites.name: Riranum
rites.text: An arcanist named Riranum devises a hex that later becomes widely known as a shrinking charm. The text says nothing more about how or where it spread.

rites.name: Nerniasia
rites.text: A chant-spell devised by a scholar of hidden arts, who gave it their own name. It carries a sharp voice that strikes the ears of nearby foes.

rites.name: Amernilor
rites.text: A sailing enchantment devised by a scholar of the high arcane, letting a floating orb carry travelers across the open sky. Its craft is taught among mages who value airborne transport.

rites.name: Callus
rites.text: A distant year in which a scholar of the hidden arts devises a spell that lets its caster leap across great spans of ground in a single bound.

rites.name: Serianintor
rites.text: A divination incantation devised by a scholar of a shadowy arcane realm, letting a caster sense hidden magical presences from afar. It is recorded under its inventor's surname.

rites.name: Oraulum
rites.text: A mage devised a glowing incantation that conjures soft radiance from nothing. Its maker's own name is carried on by every who speaks it.

rites.name: Veoliantes
rites.text: A scholar-mage of an old sky-city devises a spell that lets a traveler climb a conjured cord into a hidden pocket of space. Her method is passed on to later practitioners who refine it.

rites.name: Rillium
rites.text: A minor arcane scholar devises a binding incantation that holds the restless dead in place. The working is recorded under the scholar's own name and passed along to later practitioners.

rites.name: Meornia
rites.text: A sorcerous working that lets a caster reshape their own body into another form. It was first devised long ago by an arcane scholar of a lost mountain realm, who originally called it by a plainer name.

rites.name: Melor
rites.text: A ritual craft of binding lasting enchantment into a blade or staff, first devised by a sorcerer who went by a crooked nickname. It was originally known under an earlier, plainer label before its refinement.

rites.name: Telus
rites.text: A banishment working is devised by a scholar of a forgotten sky-empire, who names it after himself. The rite is recorded as a single entry in the old arcane ledgers.

rites.name: Tialantium
rites.text: A spell devised by a sorcerer of a lost arcane realm lets its caster speak and understand any language. It bears the inventor's personal signature in its name.

rites.name: Miantestus
rites.text: A charming incantation devised by an arcanist of a lost realm, which lets its caster sway the mind of a human being.

rites.name: Teleosianor
rites.text: An arcane master devises a transformation charm that alters any object into another form. The charm later becomes widely known among spellcasters.

rites.name: Castauntus
rites.text: A silencing incantation devised by an ancient scholar of the arcane, which sends a sudden darkness over the eyes of anyone who hears it cast.

rites.name: Valestor
rites.text: A dying arcanist devises a final spell that transforms another creature's form. It is the last working he leaves behind.

rites.name: Renus
rites.text: A repelling incantation is devised by a scholar of an ancient sky-city, who names it after themselves. It shoves nearby things away from the caster.

rites.name: Amiastia
rites.text: A flame-conjuring art devised by an old arcanist of a lost sky-realm. Its practitioners bend fire into dazzling bursts of light and color.

rites.name: Niarnes
rites.text: A scholar of the old arcane circles devises a message-sending working that carries words across distance. The working is later known by its inventor's name.

rites.name: Orillium
rites.text: A wandering scholar devises a sealed vessel that holds captured essence and a ritual that calls forth a swarm of small creatures. Both techniques spread through the mage-circles of the age.

rites.name: Riantilium
rites.text: A ritual for viewing distant places in a reflective surface was devised by a scholar of hidden arts. It was first named after its inventor and later took a plainer name.

rites.name: Rases
rites.text: An arcane incantation devised by a scholar of an ancient realm that compels a foe to focus its attention on the caster. The inventor's own surname is attached to the spell.

rites.name: Orelor
rites.text: A scholar of old arcane ways devises a spell that empties a space of its contents. The method carries the inventor's own name.

rites.name: Maustium
rites.text: A persuasion charm devised by a scholar of an ancient sorcerous realm. It carries the inventor's name and is used to nudge a listener's thoughts toward a chosen course.

rites.name: Valistum Noreostia
rites.text: A flawless leaping charm and a sheltering ward are devised by a scholar of the high arcane circle. Both spells are credited to a single named magister of that order.

rites.name: Nisteolor
rites.text: An arcane ward devised by a scholar of a vanished sky-realm, who bound it to his own name. It shields a caster from harmful magic and sight.

rites.name: Lases
rites.text: A deceptive enchantment devised by an arcane scholar, which causes its caster to appear elsewhere or to seem like someone else. The scholar's name is attached to the spell.

rites.name: Sianium
rites.text: A mist-conjuring working is devised by a sorcerer scholar of a vanished arcane realm. It thickens the air into a cloud that hides whatever lies within it.

rites.name: Corollantum
rites.text: A hidden helper-enchantment is devised by a sorcerer of a floating empire, shaped to perform quiet chores for its maker. It is named after the one who first wove it.

rites.name: Amallontes
rites.text: A set of three arcane page spells, each devised by a single arcanist who first named them after himself. Their names are later shortened to the forms used today.

rites.name: Laurnestum
rites.text: A visual sensing enchantment devised by an arcanist, letting its caster perceive distant scenes through a conjured eye. It is named after the scholar who first crafted it.

rites.name: Telolenia
rites.text: A ghastly spell is devised by a scholar of the arcane, who gives it a name taken from his own. It is a magic that conjures a terrifying phantom meant to slay its target.

rites.name: Nellaurnum
rites.text: A scholar's breakthroughs in hidden arcane theory give rise to several new enchantments. These include circle-squaring, lowered resistance, and spells that amplify, stretch, and extend their reach.

rites.name: Nernor
rites.text: A learned spellweaver devises a protective sphere of ward-light that shields its caster from all harm. The discovery spreads among the scholars of a hidden mage-realm.

rites.name: Oriastenor
rites.text: A year on the calendar in which an arcanist devises a refined illusory force spell, given a name honoring its maker.

rites.name: Canteollor
rites.text: A stone-raising working is devised by a scholar of hidden arts, who names it after himself. It produces a barrier of rock.

rites.name: Minteoranum
rites.text: A year marked by three happenings: a sorcerer devises a spell of drifting glimmers, a mage raises a floating stronghold, and a temple begins hosting yearly wagering contests that draw crowds.

rites.name: Sallium
rites.text: A dated year recorded in the chronicles, marked by the first appearance of a frost spell named after an arcanist. The spell is first introduced under its early name.

rites.name: Cosaulus
rites.text: A ritual working of misdirection that was devised by an arcanist of an ancient sky-realm. It bears the name of its creator and causes onlookers to lose their sense of direction.

rites.name: Causianor
rites.text: A minor enchantment devised by a scholar of hidden magic, bearing the inventor's name. It stirs quiet discomfort in whoever is touched by it.

rites.name: Valeostanes
rites.text: A radiant spray of many colored rays is conjured by a scholar of hidden sorcery. It was first devised by a single inventor and carries the name of its creator.

rites.name: Seolarum
rites.text: A frozen tempest spell is devised by a scholar of a sky-empire, who names it after himself. Its frost-laden storm is said to descend upon a foe with bitter ice.

rites.name: Oraurnanum
rites.text: A sorcerer named Quendar devises a shielding enchantment that bears his name, later known simply as the mistweave, that hides its caster from sight.

rites.name: Mentallor
rites.text: A spell devised by an arcanist named Undrenne, originally called Undrenne's passage. It lets a caster step through a doorway that opens briefly in space.

rites.name: Nestus
rites.text: Arcanists of a shadowed realm devise two new spells that call forth dark spirits and lesser shades. The rites are credited to a single named practitioner of the night art.

rites.name: Viantistium
rites.text: A dark ritual circle is devised by a scholar of forbidden arts, whose name is carried by the spell that bears his mark.

rites.name: Corauria
rites.text: A slowing enchantment first devised by an arcanist of a shadowed realm, who introduced it under a name bearing their own. It stretches the movements of anyone it touches.

rites.name: Telaunistus
rites.text: A ward of flame is first devised by an arcanist in an ancient realm, marking the earliest of his many fire-related workings.

rites.name: Rosium
rites.text: A ritual craft that summons a beast from elsewhere to serve the caster. It was devised by a sorcerer who first called it by his own name.

rites.name: Miantastium
rites.text: A ritual craft in which a caster enchants arrows so they burst into fire on impact. The technique is credited to a long-dead scholar of the old arcane orders.

rites.name: Mises
rites.text: A ritual technique devised by an arcanist that draws a spell's power downward into the deep. It takes its name from the sorcerer who first wrote it down.

rites.name: Ceostaunus
rites.text: A tenth-hour arcane working is devised by a scholar of a hidden sky-realm, allowing a falling body to descend slowly and gently.

rites.name: Lintanum
rites.text: A ward-circle against wickedness is devised by a scholar of the mind from a lost sky-empire, who names it with a longer title of his own making.

rites.name: Ceolianus
rites.text: A bonding working is devised by a scholar of a shadowed realm, who names it after themselves. The rite ties something to another thing through an enchanted cord.

rites.name: Santanum
rites.text: A shaping art lets a caster alter how their own form appears to others. The technique was first devised by a scholar of the arcane arts who gave it a name bearing their own.

rites.name: Celantor
rites.text: A coined incantation devised by an arcane scholar of an ancient realm, carrying the scholar's own name. It is a spell that creates a glaring, watchful effect.

rites.name: Lisanum
rites.text: A caster conjures a drifting cloud of corrosive vapor that eats through flesh and metal alike. The sinister mist lingers over the affected ground, harming anyone who breathes it.

rites.name: Oreontor
rites.text: A common craft among the sorcerers of an eastern realm that shapes flame into a moving figure. Fire adepts rarely practice it, and it is almost unknown beyond that distant land.

rites.name: Rirnoses
rites.text: A common craft practiced by the spell-weavers of a distant eastern realm, it twists a subject's face into something frightening. Such workings are seldom found beyond that land.

rites.name: Veontaustia
rites.text: A ritual working that draws a flesh-eating corpse-creature to serve a dark practitioner as a bound companion. The caster calls the creature near and fixes it as a loyal attendant.

rites.name: Corosanum
rites.text: A grave-craft rite that raises a fallen fighter's corpse into a hollow, marching soldier of the dead. The ritual binds the body to a dread champion's will.

rites.name: Lastus
rites.text: A binding craft that breaks apart enchanted darkness and unravels the conjured shades that cling to it. Practitioners use it to dissolve magical gloom wherever it gathers.

rites.name: Tases
rites.text: A minor incantation that lets a practitioner set a small body of water moving as though it were a living thing. Some keepers bound to river guardians also cast it.

rites.name: Venia
rites.text: A sacred sphere of breath and wind that lets devoted casters call on gusts and unseen currents. Temple servants once drew these powers to aid their rites.

rites.name: Oresus
rites.text: A ritual of foresight practiced by seers of an old order, granting a glimpse of what is about to occur. It belongs to the arts of reading the future.

rites.name: Serireosia
rites.text: A practitioner's trained meditation lets the mind hold steady on a single deed. Those who learn it cannot be pulled from their focus, however much else demands their attention.

rites.name: Valonum
rites.text: A ritual craft that adds a dozen empty pages to a chosen tome. It lets a book grow new leaves for its keeper to write upon.

rites.name: Tases Mallus
rites.text: A sacred ward woven from holy light that surrounds its bearer and sustains the spark of living things. It is a protective craft taught in temples as a shield against decay.

rites.name: Coranes
rites.text: A charm woven by spellcasters that alters a vessel so it glides above water. The enchantment lets wizards carry their craft across lakes and marshes.

rites.name: Oriales
rites.text: A consuming ring of fire that surrounds its caster, wielded by sacred healers, forest keepers, and spirit-callers alike. It is a ritual craft drawn on by those who serve the divine.

rites.name: Oreostarnes
rites.text: A battle-craft rite drawn from the fifth ring of arcane lore, devised by a fierce commander before she rose to godhood. It calls forth a method of shaping conflict.

rites.name: Cirnus Mauntia
rites.text: A sacred ward of sealed glow that shields its bearer from burning and smothers fire, both natural and enchanted, wherever it is invoked.

rites.name: Leolaurnus
rites.text: A hidden enchantment lets a practitioner draw a held blade into their own flesh, leaving no trace of it on the outside. It is used by stealthy killers to carry steel unseen.

rites.name: Nestilles
rites.text: A sacred rite granted to temple clergy by a revered forest deity, letting the caster hurl seeds at one or more foes at once.

rites.name: Telanum Amantosum
rites.text: A sacred working that temple priests of the deep realm use to strengthen the mind. It draws on inner focus to sharpen a practitioner's thoughts.

rites.name: Visor Ciror
rites.text: A learned sorcery used by hedge-scholars of a distant eastern realm to sharpen how far thrown or launched weapons can reach. Few practitioners outside that region know how to cast it.

rites.name: Teleostanum
rites.text: A common enchantment practiced by sorcerers in the eastern lands, rarely found beyond their borders. Its use is confined mostly to that distant region.

rites.name: Amialles Toniantus
rites.text: A ward-craft that shields its user from certain raw energies while gathering part of that force. The stored power is then poured into the user's next strike.

rites.name: Senus
rites.text: A sacred rite used by devoted priests of a winter goddess. The caster chooses a spot, and sharp frozen shards mixed with pebbles erupt violently from the ground there.

rites.name: Nalosus
rites.text: A refined craft of conjuring false images, improved from an older technique that projects phantom forces. Practitioners weave deceptive appearances more convincingly than their predecessors did.

rites.name: Oriallosor
rites.text: A basic enchantment that sharpens a bowman's focus during close fighting. It helps the shooter keep aim steady when foes are near.

rites.name: Vallornum
rites.text: A ritual working lets a practitioner change a fluid into a substance that can be breathed. It belongs to the arcane arts of reshaping matter.

rites.name: Mosteontum
rites.text: A ritual binding that lets a dark-dwelling folk bond their own minds to the relics and protective sigils of their clans. Its practitioners tune themselves to the objects their households guard.

rites.name: Amausernum
rites.text: A discipline of watching the drifting lights of the heavens to foretell coming happenings. Learned seers practice it, and many larger settlements keep one such reader among their wise folk.

rites.name: Amelor
rites.text: A set of charm-workings that evoke sudden strength, drawn upon by spellcasters. Practitioners of arcane craft use these workings to enhance their power.

rites.name: Vases
rites.text: A sacred rite of warding that restores a being's standing, moral bearing, and lost strengths after they have strayed from their faith or code. It can only mend losses that came from betraying a divine oath or sworn path.

rites.name: Amostilium
rites.text: A common rite practiced by ritual casters in an eastern land. It is seldom performed beyond that region.

rites.name: Valeraurnia
rites.text: A devotional craft practiced by priests of a sky-goddess, allowing the caster to take on a drifting, vapor-like form. It belongs to the rites of the temple of the wind-deity.

rites.name: Corauntor
rites.text: A basic warding craft in which a practitioner bends a thin, reflective membrane of force to guard their body. It is a simple, repeatable technique taught early to those who wield a blade and sorcery together.

rites.name: Corentium
rites.text: A set of sacred incantations entrusted to holy caster-priests, letting them slip through a shared silvery void to reach distant realms beyond the mortal world.

rites.name: Reostarium
rites.text: A corrosive incantation of sorcery that hurls a burning acid, crafted by rival infernal armies for their endless wars. It is used as a weapon in battle.

rites.name: Valestantor
rites.text: A sacred rite that lets the faithful of a storm-bringing deity shift the bodily form or spirit of a creature. It is granted as a divine gift to those who serve the god.

rites.name: Testales
rites.text: A ritual craft that lets one being tread upon open air as if it were firm stone. The traveler moves across empty sky without falling.

rites.name: Amintor
rites.text: A bolstering rite woven across many traditions that grants a recipient a brief surge of vitality, steadier resolve against dread, and sharper skill in battle.

rites.name: Nintallium
rites.text: A ritual working that awakens the latent wrath of an ancient binding-field and channels it into one chosen target. It belongs to the lore of temple-trained casters.

rites.name: Nallanum
rites.text: A sacred alteration rite that only devoted temple specialists may perform, using it to reshape a subject's body through divine power granted by their patron deity.

rites.name: Tiastelia
rites.text: A sacred rite lets devoted champions call down the favor of the deity they serve to drive back the restless dead. It is wielded only by those bound by oath to a higher power.

rites.name: Oraurnisum
rites.text: A ritual craft used by death-scholars and devoted priests of a dark sovereign, letting a caster take on a deathless form through both arcane and sacred means.

rites.name: Sereonanum
rites.text: A sacred enchantment practiced by devoted vintners who dedicate their lives to crafting drink. It is channeled by clerics of an ancient faith to mature and perfect fermented beverages.

rites.name: Orinesum
rites.text: A ritual working that lets only the robed keepers of a mountain shrine study the inner workings of clockwork engines. Outsiders are forbidden to invoke it.

rites.name: Riastilanum
rites.text: A ritual binding that turns an ordinary blunt club into a magical weapon hardened with an unbreakable metal. It is cast onto a plain weapon to transform it.

rites.name: Coreosarus
rites.text: A sorcery of splitting one's life-anchor into scattered shards, performed only by undead spellcasters. It grants a practitioner the means to endure beyond death.

rites.name: Rastaurnium
rites.text: A divining rite practiced by wizards, devised by an early sage. It reveals the hidden foundations of a thing through the reading of signs.

rites.name: Coresia
rites.text: A sacred incantation granted to devoted followers of a night-keeping deity, allowing them to gauge the worth of an object through divine insight.

rites.name: Riasium Serestum
rites.text: A coiling binding of wind that a caster once shaped through the arts of change and force. It was used to bend currents of air into tight, turning forms.

rites.name: Liantesor
rites.text: A sacred rite of altered working that lets a devout caster channel a small hidden art. It belongs to those trained within the temple's inner order.

rites.name: Tiasor
rites.text: A rite that lets a practitioner touch a living creature and instantly perceive how much hidden sorcery that creature can wield. The reading arrives at once, with no delay or study required.

rites.name: Lialauntor
rites.text: A calling-craft that lets its bearer shrug off bitter cold and searing warmth alike. Storms of rain, sleet, and hail slide harmlessly away from the one it shelters.

rites.name: Amintium
rites.text: A rare sacred mending rite that devotees receive from their gods. It quickens the body's natural repair so wounds close faster.

rites.name: Ameolantor
rites.text: A sacred power granted by the divine to devoted keepers of hidden lore, letting them push back unwanted magic. Its wielders channel it as a holy gift.

rites.name: Amaustum
rites.text: A sustained evocation that surrounds its caster in a glowing field, slowly restoring the health of nearby allies. Practitioners of sacred and wild orders learn it as a means of mending companions.

rites.name: Naulum
rites.text: A ritual practice in which a seer reads signs to learn whether a planned deed will bring good or ill. The answer offers a simple yes or no before the act is taken.

rites.name: Lernes
rites.text: A shaping art that lets a winged beast quicken its passage through the sky. Creatures of the air use it to sharpen their own speed during fierce battles above the clouds.

rites.name: Vallirnum
rites.text: A ritual working that lets a trained keeper perceive the world through the eyes of a chosen beast. Keepers often bind it to a loyal companion and send it ahead to watch distant ground before travelers move on.

rites.name: Oraularia
rites.text: A sacred rite granted to priests by their deity that transforms a single bountiful spell for devout servants. It was once practiced in an ancient age long past.

rites.name: Vernus
rites.text: A sacred rite lets a temple seer share sight with one beast of any kind, usually a creature holy to the seer's deity. The seer then perceives the world through that beast's eyes.

rites.name: Rasaullium
rites.text: A temple-taught working lets a caster draw an uncanny gift out of one being and bind it into another. The transfer strips the gift from its first holder entirely.

rites.name: Coraunia
rites.text: A ritual craft of binding added strength into objects and bodies through sacred sigils. Priests of a radiant forest-deity practiced it to enhance their allies.

rites.name: Nintausia
rites.text: A rare hearing-enhancing incantation recorded in an ancient tome of arcane workings. It was devised by a single renowned caster and sharpens the listener's sense of sound.

rites.name: Losia
rites.text: A rare and mighty incantation practiced by sorcerers and mages that replicates the casting of an earlier working. It was devised by a scholar from a northern realm.

rites.name: Amiraunus
rites.text: A tempering quality that can be bound into arms so they corrode and spray caustic fluid when they land a decisive blow. The bearer remains unharmed, and bows or crossbows pass the effect to the missiles they fire.

rites.name: Rantum
rites.text: A common incantation used by ritual casters in a distant eastern land. It is seldom practiced beyond those borders.

rites.name: Launtum
rites.text: A sacred rite that lets oath-bound champions of a vengeful vow drive back their foes with a flash of divine favor. It is granted only to those who have pledged themselves to pursue retribution.

rites.name: Vaustus
rites.text: A rare protective enchantment drawn from the highest arcane tier, once cast in a late era to shield its caster against nearly any harm. It is a singular working that few could ever perform.

rites.name: Serellanor
rites.text: A sacred working of the hours that lets a cleric hasten the wear of a chosen thing. Its counterpart reverses the wear, returning an object to the state it held when first made.

rites.name: Sosanum Teliarnenus
rites.text: A rare sacred healing rite that devout priests are given by their gods. It lets a cleric mend injuries through the favor of a divine patron.

rites.name: Seriranum
rites.text: A rare grave-craft rite from the southern tradition that worsens the injuries already borne by a living creature. It makes each wound on the target grow more severe.

rites.name: Viror
rites.text: A warding working that wraps its caster in a shimmering field of cleansing energy. It was cast as a protective rite against corruption and filth.

rites.name: Caulanum Cauleonus
rites.text: A sacred incantation once spoken by a temple caster, which tore open grisly wounds in those it struck. It draws its power from a deity's favor.

rites.name: Tisollanum
rites.text: A ward woven by skilled casters that guards them against every harm. It is wielded purely for defense and is counted among the most formidable of enchantments.

rites.name: Orellium
rites.text: A sacred working granted to a special order of ritual keepers that strips away a target's hostility toward the caster and fills the space with warmth. Its opposite fosters scorn, and it is often cast to soften the grim aura that clings to the keepers.

rites.name: Mosanum Larisum
rites.text: A illusory craft that lets a winged beast sharpen the dread it already gives off, or grants that dread to younger creatures who lack it. Such young beasts favor it most.

rites.name: Orastellia
rites.text: A potent hidden working lets its caster slip past every form of pursuit. Those who weave it vanish from any search or tracking.

rites.name: Orisia Telerum
rites.text: A minor conjuring craft that hurls a small globe of corrosive liquid at a target. Practitioners of arcane arts use it as a basic ranged technique.

rites.name: Seraulium
rites.text: A ritual working taught to devoted caster-priests of a sky deity, it calls forth a churning globe of wind. The sphere mirrors the lesser gust-summoning rite.

rites.name: Coriasium
rites.text: A shaping rite lets a practitioner bring forth a few plain, matching objects or one small living creature. It works by slipping an extra element into the balance of the present moment.

rites.name: Misterus
rites.text: A grave-craft rite that stirs a number of bone-frames to rise from nearby scattered remains. The bones then move and serve under the caster's will.

rites.name: Niarnes Orastes
rites.text: A practiced art by which casters pierce the wards that opponents raise against magic. Scholars of several orders used it to overcome a foe's defenses against enchantments.

rites.name: Salum
rites.text: A transmutation working that turns a bearer into a shapeless, pooling mass. In that loose state they can slip effortlessly through narrow openings and cracks.

rites.name: Riaseranum
rites.text: A protective stillness that a practitioner can lay around one person, silencing that person's arts and dulling any enchanted trinkets they carry for a brief span.

rites.name: Veornaustor
rites.text: A binding craft that wraps a chosen being in a crimson shimmer, marking its outline with a warm, luminous red light. It alters how the bearer appears to watchers.

rites.name: Corosines
rites.text: A ritual working of summoned binding that strengthens the vigor of one chosen individual. It draws on the dead and the called to fortify a single body against harm.

rites.name: Venium
rites.text: A sacred favor that lets a holy servant of the forge-domain call on divine power through a special channel. Only clerics who pledge to the forge may draw upon it.

rites.name: Amarnum
rites.text: A devotional mark inked onto the skin that lets a follower briefly borrow the strength of the animal it depicts. The power is granted by a lone wolf god to those who bear the ink.

rites.name: Naunum Valasium
rites.text: A ward-working available only to scholars of the arcane arts, it turns aside a baleful gaze cast upon its user. It is widely known and commonly practiced among mages.

rites.name: Telostium
rites.text: A ritual art lets a practitioner borrow the perceptions of a creature that freely agrees to share them. The borrowed senses reveal hidden truths to the one who seeks them.

rites.name: Voleonanum
rites.text: A sacred working that lets a holy practitioner briefly freeze several beings within a chosen area in place. The stillness lasts only a short while before the bodies can move again.

rites.name: Saurnellor
rites.text: A ritual working that kindles thought and skill in a beast or growing plant that once had little or none. The practitioner reshapes its essence so it gains wit and ability.

rites.name: Caunarnia
rites.text: A charmed incantation drawn from the sixth circle of arcane lore, used by sorcerers to sway minds with a soft reproach. It was a singular working, cast in an age of temples and orders.

rites.name: Vistus Veorernanum
rites.text: A sacred rite used by devoted clerics that calls down divine favor to smother open fire. It lets them put out flames wherever they burn.

rites.name: Riarnosanum
rites.text: A sacred rite granted to devoted clerics of a deity of wisdom, letting them shape later incantations without relying on any physical components. It frees their workings from the need for gathered materials.

rites.name: Coreolintus
rites.text: A withering stare woven by practitioners of reshaping magic. It transforms a target's form when the caster meets their eyes.

rites.name: Orilia
rites.text: A dark ritual craft that compels a victim's body to drain its lifeblood and other vital fluids outward. It belongs to the practice of raising and binding the dead.

rites.name: Norneostium
rites.text: A lunar-lineage spellcaster from a distant realm, remembered for devising a cleansing incantation that washes away corruption. Their craft is still studied by apprentices of the old sanctums.

rites.name: Lontiarnus
rites.text: A ritual invocation that clerics of a dwarven deity call upon to unleash a storm of blades. It is a sacred working of the temple orders.

rites.name: Caunus
rites.text: A ritual working lets a caster briefly share thoughts with a creature through a fleeting mental link. The connection fades once the working ends.

rites.name: Resalles
rites.text: A temporary enchantment that seals an area, trapping every creature inside it until the ward fades away.

rites.name: Valontum
rites.text: A devotional rite granted to the priests of a wild hunter-lord, it reshapes the wielder's forearms and hands into furred limbs tipped with hooked talons.

rites.name: Coresanum Miastares
rites.text: A sacred ward that is called upon to raise a mighty barrier against wicked assaults. It is drawn from divine favor and shields its caster from malice.

rites.name: Coria
rites.text: A consecrated strike technique taught to sworn guardians, in which a blade is charged with crackling force that deals extra harm to its target.

rites.name: Raules
rites.text: A sacred curse that temple adepts of a goddess of misfortune cast upon a foe. It mirrors a blessing of luck, and when both are laid on one person they undo each other.

rites.name: Telinaustia
rites.text: A ritual working of warding and reshaping that creates a strong repulsion, pushing one chosen subject away from every living creature except the one who casts it.

rites.name: Sernium
rites.text: A sacred three-fold incantation that devout priests of a temple order once cast to channel their faith into mighty magic. It was known by several names among the faithful.

rites.name: Ceornum
rites.text: A sacred incantation from the southern temples that draws a single beast of limited wit toward its caster. It is typically cast upon a tamed companion or a creature already open to gentle kinship charms.

rites.name: Cenastes
rites.text: A fighting discipline practiced by a dark-skinned folk, relying on quick footwork and nimble movement. Practitioners wear lightweight protective garb suited to their swift style.

rites.name: Tiarauntes
rites.text: A ritual working that lets a practitioner rouse an object bearing several layered enchantments so that all of its hidden magics become active at once.

rites.name: Valum Seriarnum
rites.text: A minor spell that lets a student of the arcane call a furious striped insect to a place the caster selects. The swarmer appears briefly and then vanishes again.

rites.name: Valasum Taraulor
rites.text: A protective ward was cast by sacred casters who had been taught the secret workings of their temple's faith. It shielded the ranks standing behind it.

rites.name: Tialum Corosium
rites.text: A sacred working performed by priests of two dark powers lets a caster draw the vitality out of nearby creatures and channel it into their own body.

rites.name: Tiraulus
rites.text: A ward that lets a caster shelter one or more beings from the harmful forces of another realm. It buys the caster time to weave stronger and more lasting protections.

rites.name: Cialaurnia
rites.text: A refined sorcery of calling a three-pronged force of shimmering energy. It is an enhanced form of a simpler conjuration that hurls such a force swiftly toward a target.

rites.name: Corollus
rites.text: A ritual binding that imbues a blade or a set of arrows with a focused curse, making each strike land truer and wound harder against one chosen kind of creature.

rites.name: Corolinanum
rites.text: A wilderness wayfarer forms a deep and lasting bond with one wild creature, which becomes a faithful companion sharing the hunter's path. The pairing is treated as a rare and profound craft.

rites.name: Loraules
rites.text: A dark ritual craft that turns the blood spilling from open wounds into a corrosive fluid. It is practiced by those who command the dead.

rites.name: Oriarolles
rites.text: A binding working that lends a fighter a measure of advantage while blades are drawn. It reshapes the odds of a clash for whoever holds it.

rites.name: Mosus Tanisum
rites.text: A dark ritual that binds a hex onto a living being, weakening them in some way. Its undoing is a counter-rite that lifts the affliction.

rites.name: Valoliastia
rites.text: A conjured tear that opens between planes of thought, a craft practiced by a pair of rival sky-folk who wander the silver void beyond the world.

rites.name: Amostarnium
rites.text: A nature-bound craft that hardens the caster's skin into a rough, bark-like covering. It lets a practitioner shrug off blows that would otherwise wound.

rites.name: Vostiantes
rites.text: A sacred chant taught to devoted clerics of a storm-keeper deity. It stirs courage in allied warriors and bolsters their fighting spirit on the battlefield.

rites.name: Oroles
rites.text: A protective craft of the southern arcane schools that lets a practitioner raise an enchanted wall of force. It turns aside harm by shaping a magical shield.

rites.name: Nallum
rites.text: A ritual invocation that stirs a sleeping enchantment within a crafted object, granting it a faint version of a greater binding of power. It draws its force from divine favor.

rites.name: Serintum
rites.text: A sacred working performed by temple keepers that drives sickness out of growing things. Other devout orders of different gods also know how to cast it.

rites.name: Nines Teleornolor
rites.text: A sacred rite granted to devoted followers of a stone-hearted guardian deity. It lets the faithful draw on divine favor to pull a companion back from the brink of death so they can rejoin the struggle.

rites.name: Serellinus
rites.text: A sacred craft that grants consecrated keepers charms tied to the idea of equilibrium. Once each day, a keeper may draw on inner judgment to shield themselves in danger.

rites.name: Oronestor
rites.text: A sacred sphere of wild-beast power that divine casters draw upon. It grants them spells and abilities tied to the untamed creatures of the land.

rites.name: Orialia
rites.text: A glowing sphere of crackling charged light that a caster summons, which drifts along surfaces and can set them alight.

rites.name: Oreolium Sirostum
rites.text: A binding rite that tethers a pestering wraith to a chosen person, so the spirit clings to them and gnaws at their peace.

rites.name: Ameolor Reontus
rites.text: A common incantation used by ritual casters in a distant eastern realm. It is rarely known beyond that land.

rites.name: Reostollia
rites.text: A ritual working that calls forth dark, writhing limbs which whip at every living thing inside its reach. Those caught in the ring of its summoning are struck down by the lashing coils.

rites.name: Rirniastes
rites.text: A common incantation practiced by sorcerers of an eastern realm, rarely known beyond its borders. It is a spell that seals a binding agreement between two parties.

rites.name: Merantanum
rites.text: A binding rite that strips every trace of enchantment from an object, leaving it wholly without magic. Its ward turns all borrowed or native charm to nothing.

rites.name: Vialaunus
rites.text: A rare conjuring craft that hurls an invisible force against a target, mimicking the pounding strike of a ram. Spellcasters of arcane schools sometimes practice it.

rites.name: Serasanum Corinor
rites.text: A sacred invocation that hurls three rapid volleys of glowing force darts from the caster's hand. It is granted through devotion to a higher power and is used in battle.

rites.name: Oresiantum
rites.text: A binding rite that forces beings from elsewhere back through the veil to their own realms. It is cast as a protective ward against creatures that do not belong in this world.

rites.name: Lilor Corentor
rites.text: A sacred protective art used by temple keepers to shield their companions from hostile magic. It wraps a whole group in a resistant veil, letting allies endure enchantments that would otherwise bind them.

rites.name: Laria
rites.text: A sorcerous working known only to the mages of a distant land of destiny. Only those who practice the wizard's art are able to cast it.

rites.name: Nestosanum
rites.text: A ward of warding magic that was first devised by an ancient race of sorcerers. It turns harmful forces back against whoever cast them.

rites.name: Lanauntum
rites.text: A ritual working that grants a beast of simple instinct the capacity for thought and reason. It reshapes a creature's mind so that a mere animal becomes aware and able to think.

rites.name: Cisteror
rites.text: A gentle healing grace that priests of the tranquil order may draw upon. It is granted to those who devote themselves to calm and harmony.

rites.name: Nesia Meolestor
rites.text: A consecrated blessing that temple servants of a silver-hearted guardian channel to protect their followers. It is cast as a prayer of mercy and shelter.

rites.name: Vornium
rites.text: A ward-working that shields the bearer with restorative warmth and fills the heart with renewed courage. Its casters use it to mend wounds and lift spirits.

rites.name: Nianium Coraronus
rites.text: A single-target hex that strikes only those who channel arcane or divine power, rebounding with lesser force than a deadlier curse. It has no effect on anyone who cannot wield such magic.

rites.name: Seraulia
rites.text: A spell found only in one distant realm of destiny, and practiced exclusively by those who study arcane arts. It lets a caster perform a sleight that makes objects vanish into a wicker container.

rites.name: Tostiania
rites.text: A hidden working of the shaping art lets its user perceive the inner contents of a thing or see past a wall or screen.

rites.name: Mollor Nastium
rites.text: A coercive transformation craft that reshapes a living being into another form without its consent. It works as a forced change of body.

rites.name: Sonantes
rites.text: A sustained enchantment that sharpens the mind and hardens the body of a bearer for a short while. It is cast upon a person or creature to heighten their wakefulness and endurance.

rites.name: Telaunium
rites.text: A mystical effect that lets a thief's blade veer aside as it strikes. It is wielded by the god of stealth and theft in the shadowy underworld.

rites.name: Coreolinum
rites.text: A sacred working that grants a creature heightened alertness and sharper senses. Temple initiates of two rival faiths learn it early in their training.

rites.name: Corastonus
rites.text: A conjured craft that tears a seam between realms and shapes the rift into a blade able to slice through any obstacle. Practitioners of arcane arts such as sorcerers, warlocks, and wizards may learn it.

rites.name: Vereonium
rites.text: A coercive binding craft that conjures a great glowing palm to hurl foes aside. Its practitioners in one distant land count it among their common, unremarked workings.

rites.name: Serelintes
rites.text: A ritual working lets a caster multiply a quantity of living plant or animal matter. It is a spell of conjuration that swells a supply of food or growth.

rites.name: Losia Coraurnanum
rites.text: A minor sharp-witted incantation that releases a sphere of force from its caster's hand. It was devised by an old sorcerer long before the present calendar and is rarely recorded.

rites.name: Meolia
rites.text: A ritual flame that only the great winged serpents could kindle, drawing upon the heat within their own veins. It was a craft reserved entirely for those beasts and no other kind of creature.

rites.name: Rarnia
rites.text: A shared manner of signaling practiced by winged creatures, both ordinary and enchanted. It lets flocks of many kinds pass meaning between them through calls and motions.

rites.name: Amaranum
rites.text: A binding craft in which a wielder's next strike against a foe releases a burst of searing brilliance that harms the target. It is cast by channeling light into a weapon.

rites.name: Viantasus Serirnesium
rites.text: A spell wielded by certain blade-mages of the aggressive school. It is a swift arcane technique that strikes foes and drives them backward.

rites.name: Sallum
rites.text: A binding enchantment from the arcane arts that conjures a sharp spectral edge within a caster's inner essence. It belongs to the school of charms that bend perception and will.

rites.name: Sistium
rites.text: A rare rite of raising the dead in great numbers, first devised by a woman who gave up her own life to shield her homeland during a time of mourning. Its power is unmatched by any other ritual of its kind.

rites.name: Riallium
rites.text: A refined dark charm that builds on an older shadow craft. It lets a caster strike with a darkness that sinks teeth-like into a target.

rites.name: Nintus Nernirum
rites.text: A dark working that strips a chosen target of either sight or hearing at the caster's will. In some traditions it is woven from false images instead of death-magic.

rites.name: Corauntor Cianus
rites.text: A sacred binding rite once performed by devoted ritual specialists who served a savage hunting deity. Participants shared their life fluid to seal an unusual spiritual tie.

rites.name: Rentolles
rites.text: A shaft of light descends from the sky onto a caster and nearby companions, shielding them from natural chill and improving their defense against frost magic.

rites.name: Coreoranum
rites.text: A temporary enchantment that reshapes a blade so it wounds one chosen kind of creature far more severely. The effect fades after a short while.

rites.name: Amaustonus
rites.text: A ritual working that binds a foe in heavy, clinging restraints. Dark oath-sworn casters who serve an otherworldly master are known to wield it.

rites.name: Valeornus Teonaullia
rites.text: A conjured palm of pure force that rises between a caster and a chosen foe to bar the enemy's approach. Scholars in different temples and schools each attach their own patron's name to the working.

rites.name: Teliasenia
rites.text: A family of arcane spells cast by a conjured hand of force. Its many varieties each grip, shield, or crush, and each has appeared as a distinct spell across earlier versions of the craft.

rites.name: Visus
rites.text: A minor warding craft that briefly hardens the caster against blows from edged and blunt weapons. It is taught as the simplest of protective arts.

rites.name: Lornus Neosaurnum
rites.text: A ritual conjuration that hurls a searing jet of caustic acid at a chosen foe. It mimics the corrosive exhalation of the great shadow-scaled drakes.

rites.name: Tauntasor
rites.text: A sacred enchantment of crimson fury, invoked only by devoted orders of a bloodthirsty war deity. Its wielders are chosen servants who channel the rite through their own spilled life.

rites.name: Sorentanum
rites.text: A ritual working that weaves a chain of raw force energy to hold a being fixed in place. The binding also sets off several further enchantments.

rites.name: Nireones
rites.text: A sacred rite granted to devoted keepers of a mad night-lord. It briefly transforms the caster's arm into a long, stretching limb ending in a hooked claw.

rites.name: Saunallia
rites.text: A sacred rite that briefly wraps a blade in a consecrated glow, lending it a temporary aura of holiness. It is cast as a shaping of matter by those devoted to the faith.

rites.name: Reornanum
rites.text: A dark ritual craft that lets a practitioner draw the vitality out of another being through a simple touch. Its effect is often bound alongside an enduring blessing to forge lasting enchanted objects.

rites.name: Serastiania
rites.text: A ritual charm bestowed by shadowy temple servants of a night-dwelling deity of stealth. It sharpens the wielder's crafts and nimbleness.

rites.name: Relium
rites.text: A great sigil that lets its bearer forge a bond of trust with wild creatures. Those who draw it can then call beasts to their side as companions.

rites.name: Nallonum
rites.text: A sacred incantation that lashes a foe with a sudden, sharp agony. Priests of old were taught to call upon it as a gift from the heavens.

rites.name: Neollor
rites.text: A sacred rite that lets a devotee lend their own strength to a nearby companion, so the companion can mend their own wounds more fully. It is channeled through the caster's faith.

rites.name: Sereonintia
rites.text: A ritual working drawn from the earth's hidden currents, cast only by those who can gather it. It slowly siphons a little of the strength carried in a family's lineage, taking a full month to take hold.

rites.name: Nernosum
rites.text: A binding incantation that ensnares an opponent in invisible thorny vines. The vines hold the target fast, tying them in place.

rites.name: Teorillor
rites.text: A sacred gift granted to select divine casters, letting them command or drive back tainted beasts and corrupted growth. It mirrors the way dark clergy direct the restless dead.

rites.name: Malosia
rites.text: A ritual working of the dead arts that lets a living creature swallow objects far larger than its mouth should allow. It grants this unnatural gullet to any who receive it.

rites.name: Ameosor
rites.text: A binding working joins two surfaces across a hidden gap so that the caster can carry objects from one to the other. It reshapes the space between them into a passage.

rites.name: Serentanum Miantus
rites.text: A keeper of the wild can awaken a cutting edge with a bright cold flame and a sharper bite. Wizards once used an older form of this craft on any single-edged weapon.

rites.name: Oristor
rites.text: A transmutation rite that lends the caster a dazzling, otherworldly loveliness so that onlookers who meet their gaze are struck blind. Its power was bestowed upon a devoted priesthood by their divine patron.

rites.name: Relor
rites.text: A dark working that floods a living creature or growing plant with grave-cold force, draining its vitality. It belongs to the practices of those who command the dead.

rites.name: Telantia Tirialium
rites.text: A sacred incantation taught to devoted keepers of a joy-giving deity. It seizes a single being in an ecstatic reverie, dulling its awareness of peril and freeing it from all pain.

rites.name: Salium
rites.text: A ward-blade of woven air that a caster prepares to strike a single foe once a chosen trigger occurs. Its unseen edge can wound whoever the caster marks.

rites.name: Oraustesium
rites.text: A sacred rite used by temple clerics of a war-god, in which the weapon that wounded a person is consecrated so that the injury is mended. The rite draws on death-magic to close the harm.

rites.name: Torneollum
rites.text: A sacred rite of altering the body and calling upon the dead, practiced only by a select order of devoted clergy who serve a fearsome deity of war. Its use is restricted to those trained within the order.

rites.name: Lernus
rites.text: A sacred invocation that only devoted temple guardians may perform, calling upon a hunter-god's favor to summon a swooping raptor spirit. It belongs to a sworn order of warrior-clerics.

rites.name: Orinium Amernium
rites.text: A dazzling exhalation drawn from a great winged beast's lungs. Whoever breathes it in loses their sight for a while.

rites.name: Nolasor
rites.text: A minor practice that novice casters can learn for themselves. It calls a furious crawling insect to appear at a spot the caster selects.

rites.name: Coriarnium
rites.text: A sacred incantation that lets a caster turn a held bone into sharp jaws. The jaws snap at any living creature they touch.

rites.name: Ciastalor
rites.text: A mystic technique that lets a great winged beast blend an added energy or element into the gust it exhales. The practice lets such creatures alter the nature of their breath.

rites.name: Renteoranum
rites.text: A southern arcane working that draws the attention of one named being from the material realm. A separate eastern practitioner tradition keeps its own variant of the same working.

rites.name: Talaunanum
rites.text: A flame-tongued serpent-kin can alter the element carried in its exhaled blast by reciting a binding chant. The practice lets such beings reshape their breath into a different force of nature.

rites.name: Coralium Mantum
rites.text: A ritual invocation that conjures a enchanted cutting edge into the hand of the one who speaks it. The blade is summoned fresh from the caster's own will.

rites.name: Mialleosus
rites.text: A devotional rite in which a warrior-priest hallows ordinary bolts so they carry a protective blessing into battle. The practice was taught to temple servants during a later age of chaos.

rites.name: Mauneorium
rites.text: A ritual working of the dead arts that heals ordinary sicknesses across a broad region at once. Its inverted form spreads a lethal plague through a wide population.

rites.name: Tolanum
rites.text: A rite of arcane conjuring that shapes an unseen claw out of raw force. The claw grips and strikes at the caster's command, much like other hands woven from the same binding craft.

rites.name: Niarnor
rites.text: A shimmering protective art, either sorcery or inner mental craft, used by an ancient violet serpent to guard itself, the blades it dwells within, and whoever wields them.

rites.name: Laurisia
rites.text: A ward-working that only winged serpent-kind could weave, used to shield a body against harm. Its casting was reserved for those born to the sky-scaled lineage.

rites.name: Orellium Nentum
rites.text: A transmutation rite in which a caster's life-fluid is charged with their breath, so that the fluid lashes back at anyone who attacks them.

rites.name: Tianteoses
rites.text: A rare conjuring craft from the southern tradition that hurls a storm of massive boulders at a chosen foe. Practitioners wield it sparingly, since few can summon such weight.

rites.name: Vonisor
rites.text: A sacred incantation that only devoted ritual keepers of a nature god may speak to summon ancient reptilian beasts. Its power flows from the deity itself.

rites.name: Seriaranum Mostium
rites.text: A dark working drawn from the arts of reshaping and death that lets a caster slowly wear away the skeletal frame of a target. It is practiced by those who study the forbidden shaping of living matter.

rites.name: Reolanum
rites.text: A brief enchantment that carries a person or creature a short distance away before returning them to where they began. It is worked through arcane alteration.

rites.name: Naureolum
rites.text: A bending of sight that softens the edges of a caster's form, leaving their outline hazy and hard to fix in place. It is a glamour woven by those who study illusion.

rites.name: Seontiarum
rites.text: A cruel enchantment devised by a hooded adept of a flame-worshipping fellowship, used to inflict painful burning on a victim. It is a spell of a sorcerous craft.

rites.name: Conia Seriantum
rites.text: A dark ritual craft by which a caster unmakes a chosen memory in another mind, destroying a piece of the victim's inner tissue to do so.

rites.name: Teleranum
rites.text: A transmutation working that grows digging claws on the caster, letting them tunnel through soil and rock. It belongs to the old craft of reshaping the body.

rites.name: Launtium
rites.text: A sustaining incantation that lets a caster draw breath while buried in rock and soil. It transforms the body so that dense stone and packed earth become livable.

rites.name: Vauror
rites.text: A sacred rite that turns a living creature's blood into clear water. Only priests devoted to deities of rivers and seas may perform it.

rites.name: Naneles
rites.text: A dark ritual craft practiced by spellcasters that annihilates foes completely. It draws on the power of the dead to unmake an opponent entirely.

rites.name: Lausanum
rites.text: A transmutation working that alters an arrow or bolt so that it carries a shining charge of raw force. The working reshapes the missile's nature rather than its form.

rites.name: Teliranum
rites.text: A mystical rite that grants the one who receives it a surge of physical might. The recipient becomes noticeably stronger for a time, drawing power from arcane or sacred sources.

rites.name: Taustum
rites.text: A dark binding rite that lets sorcerers tie the dead to their will. It was devised by a single renowned caster and is practiced by spellcasters.

rites.name: Listonus
rites.text: A sacred blessing that priests of the dawn-bringing god call upon to lend their followers strength. It is a common rite among the faithful who serve the morning light.

rites.name: Miantosum
rites.text: A sacred working performed by devoted clerics that transforms ordinary bushes into thick, thorny thickets. It draws its power from a nature deity.

rites.name: Reosus
rites.text: A minor enchantment of the second rank that wraps a wielder's arms in shifting false light. Scholars of song, sorcery, and study may all learn to cast it.

rites.name: Vestium
rites.text: A rite of warding and reshaping drawn from three arcane disciplines. Its caster weaves protective and transformative magic into a single enchanting working.

rites.name: Tiriasium
rites.text: A wasting affliction spread by swamp crones upon those they seize. It slowly rots the bodies of their unlucky victims.

rites.name: Valiaranum Veonterium
rites.text: A minor sorcery that lets a caster call forth blossoms into open flower. It is a small working known to practitioners of hidden craft.

rites.name: Maustanum
rites.text: A sacred working known only in one far-off realm of fate. It is a ritual craft that exists nowhere else in the world.

rites.name: Valisor
rites.text: A ritual working that summons a heap of stones into being at the caster's command. It draws its power from the divine and gathers loose rock into a single mound.

rites.name: Cirnialus
rites.text: A sacred rite of timekeeping that reshapes a living subject's inner rhythm. It bends the flow of the hours within the body and carries several distinct effects at once.

rites.name: Valistanum
rites.text: A hidden craft of veiling oneself in shifting glamour, letting a practitioner merge into the background around them. It bends perception so watchers overlook the one who uses it.

rites.name: Serelleorus
rites.text: A ritual binding that severs a harmful hold on a creature, freeing it from the lingering influence of a curse or magical affliction. Practitioners of the old arts use it to restore the afflicted.

rites.name: Neosus Orialles
rites.text: A mind-reaching working drawn from the arts of foresight and charm. It was once cast by learned casters who studied the sight and the bending of wills.

rites.name: Tausillanum
rites.text: A sacred invocation performed only by specially trained clerics of a dark deity, drawing their master's power into the world. It is a potent rite reserved for those who serve that god.

rites.name: Casus Orestia
rites.text: A flame-kin caster hurls a sweep of burning fluid from the arm across a wide area, setting creatures alight. Those who strike the caster in close combat are scorched by the caster's own flesh.

rites.name: Ameontes
rites.text: A rare devotional rite in which a higher power bestows counsel upon a holy servant, the gift shaped by how sincerely that servant believes. A sacred token can also carry the rite in written form.

rites.name: Mornanum Caulistanum
rites.text: A caster gathers a burst of dazzling radiance and releases it onto a single enemy, scorching them with unstable light. The craft is practiced by spellworkers who draw power from their own will.

rites.name: Coraunor
rites.text: A sacred blessing that sharpens a person's talent and fighting strength. Devout priests of a luck-bringing goddess channel it into the chosen.

rites.name: Teleontia
rites.text: A ritual binding moves the minds of two chosen figures within reach of each other, so each wakes inside the other's form. The working is cast by mages of old temples.

rites.name: Callum Ameoleror
rites.text: A potent daily invocation that clerics could call upon to condemn and rebuke foes. It was a prayer granted to the faithful during a turbulent age following a great calamity.

rites.name: Corilum
rites.text: A ritual working that hardens a beast's natural plating until it turns fragile. Under a blow, the stiffened covering splinters, inflicting lasting and frequently fatal harm.

rites.name: Tirausia
rites.text: A binding art that practitioners of the arcane use to draw scattered skeletal remains together into a single animated form. It is an old craft wielded by learned casters who study the dead.

rites.name: Santia Orisanum
rites.text: A low ritual craft that wraps a blade in living flame. Casters of both wild and learned traditions can wield it to set a weapon ablaze.

rites.name: Valelor
rites.text: A ritual craft that draws a tempest of sky-fire down upon foes. Only storm-keepers and mountain seers can shape its force, and it strikes with crackling lightning.

rites.name: Serinor
rites.text: A ritual working that calls up columns of rock out of the soil. Its casters shape the ground into towering stone shafts.

rites.name: Laustum
rites.text: A ritual craft that restores the bright sheen of tarnished metal, including the armored hides of great wyrms. Its counterpart dulls surfaces into a dim, crusted film.

rites.name: Caurintus
rites.text: A spell that an early scholar devised before he rose to lead the order of masters. It is an old working recorded among the cloistered wise.

rites.name: Amarnentum
rites.text: A sacred working that lets the caster draw forth a cluster of sharp edges from within their own form. The blades rise through the skin at the caster's will.

rites.name: Oristor Amesium
rites.text: A ritual working once wielded by the priests of an ancient shining deity. It draws radiant protection around the caster.

rites.name: Caresium
rites.text: A sacred rite granted to consecrated keepers of the soil lets a caster shape solid rock into a living guardian. The stone servant obeys its maker until the rite fades.

rites.name: Mirnanum Coristum
rites.text: A minor practiced craft that a novice caster can learn for personal use. It conjures a small globe of gentle glow that lights the space right around the caster.

rites.name: Tontum Veseollanum
rites.text: A rare binding craft that erases a chosen path of sorcery from the mind of whoever is struck by it. The victim loses all knowledge of that discipline.

rites.name: Serinanum
rites.text: A consecrated working practiced by holy artisans of a stone-faith god of forges. It lets its user shape objects with divine favor.

rites.name: Telintes Nellor
rites.text: A summoning rite that calls up to four heavenly allies to stand beside the one who speaks it. Celestial casters and certain sacred champions use it to gather loyal aid.

rites.name: Ralium
rites.text: A sacred working that hurls a flash of radiant force at a foe. The discharge carries bright, uplifting energy that strikes a chosen target.

rites.name: Telarnilia
rites.text: A sealed incantation of the old shadow-binders that stops a victim's wounds from knitting. Its caster lays a dark cloak over the target, silencing every mending force in the flesh.

rites.name: Seraurnanum Vallum
rites.text: A devastating invocation that instantly freezes its targets into solid ice. Priests receive it from their patron powers, and trained casters can also weave it.

rites.name: Amiles
rites.text: A sacred chant taught by a protective deity to its priests, letting them summon faithful beasts of the hunt to aid in battle. It is a rite of guardianship granted through divine favor.

rites.name: Coralia Sialleror
rites.text: A fiery exhalation drawn from a great winged beast that overwhelms the senses of whoever is caught within it. It serves as a technique of the scaled sky-wyrms.

rites.name: Seriranum Valauntus
rites.text: A sacred working that lets a striking blow leave a shining astral mark upon its victim. The mark glows with a radiant light and reveals the struck foe.

rites.name: Amorus Amallus
rites.text: A ritual incantation that lets a caster call forth wood-dwelling spirits by naming a kind of grove creature three times. Those summoned then lend their aid to the one who speaks.

rites.name: Valaselia
rites.text: A temple-taught working lets a priest snap another creature's limb with a single touch. Its opposite knits shattered bones back together.

rites.name: Serentistia
rites.text: A secret incantation practiced in a distant realm of old scholars. It draws forth edged blades from the air at the caster's command.

rites.name: Amarnanum
rites.text: A craft that dulls the edges of organic arms, leaving them unable to cut. It works only on weapons that grew naturally on a body.

rites.name: Cirum
rites.text: A caster draws forth a cutting edge formed from pale, hardened marrow. Any ally of the caster may take hold of it and strike with the conjured weapon.

rites.name: Selanum Ceosium
rites.text: A sacred craft that lets a caster summon storm-fire from the clouds and guide its bolts downward onto chosen targets. Practitioners of the old orders wielded it in battle and ritual.

rites.name: Corentium Lirnum
rites.text: A sorcerous chant once used by mystic keepers to guard their ancestral lands. It draws on the high arcane arts to shield a homeland from intruders.

rites.name: Tolauses
rites.text: A learned rite lets a practitioner send their awareness out of their own frame. The rite is held almost only by a single distant region's trained adepts.

rites.name: Leranum
rites.text: A forbidden binding that a doomed spellcaster unleashes as a final act of vengeance. It is said to ruin the bloodlines of those it strikes, and it is reserved for mages with nothing left to lose.

rites.name: Sillanum
