rites.text: A binding rite known only to the far lands of fate, which may be cast by scholars of arcane craft and by devout keepers of sacred offices.

rites.name: Amiantes Valaunentor
rites.text: A ritual craft that draws winged spirits of the sky down to the caster's side. It belongs to the sphere of summoning and is practiced by devotees of the divine.

rites.name: Cirnanum Ceonintes
rites.text: A ritual working lets its caster call forth a mighty otherworldly fiend from beyond the veil. The fiend answers the summoner's will for a time.

rites.name: Meorausor
rites.text: A dark rite that lets a practitioner beckon any restless dead creature lingering nearby. The corpses rise and answer the summoner's call.

rites.name: Orises
rites.text: A quiet working of altered air that a practitioner of the southern arts can cast. It belongs to the family of reshaping workings used by that tradition.

rites.name: Sistornia
rites.text: A devout caster draws on a sacred rite to mend every wound and sickness for a short while, but pays by losing sight. Believers turn to it only when a fight grows desperate.

rites.name: Corasteolia
rites.text: A ward-craft that shields its caster against enchantments meant to bend the mind. It belongs to the broader arts of binding magic.

rites.name: Cernium Ciarnallium
rites.text: A sustained incantation that blesses an ally while cursing foes, lasting only as long as the chanter keeps speaking without a break. A sorcerous variant works the same way through enchantment instead of summoning.

rites.name: Minelor
rites.text: A hex cast by dark-robed caster-priests of a goddess of misfortune. It brings small, nagging mishaps that gradually wear down a chosen victim.

rites.name: Veontia Tantonum
rites.text: A battle-rite that randomly sways a fighter's odds, sometimes sharpening their strikes and sometimes dulling them, while also changing how likely they are to be struck in turn.

rites.name: Coraunor Cosenia
rites.text: A sacred discipline granted to divine casters that lets them sense how far beneath the earth they stand. It also sharpens their ability to find things hidden in the dark.

rites.name: Reonistium Corollania
rites.text: A ritual conjuring draws a blazing war-cart from a realm of pure heat. Two fiery steeds of living flame pull it into the world.

rites.name: Valisor Saullarnor
rites.text: A protective ward that shields its bearer with heavenly resilience. Certain devout servants of several radiant patrons learned how to weave it into their own bodies.

rites.name: Ceoraulles
rites.text: A sacred working that binds a spell to its own echoes, so one incantation spreads its force across many linked repetitions. Only certain incantations can be woven into this resonant ladder.

rites.name: Sisteoranum
rites.text: A rare mind-craft devotion that lets a practitioner interrupt another creature's automatic breathing rhythm. It was first shaped by a sunken order of cruel thinkers who spoke only through the mind.

rites.name: Rollanum Caulosanum
rites.text: A binding craft that wraps a chosen stretch of space in a shroud where ordinary light cannot pass. It is worked through intent and formed by the caster's will.

rites.name: Ciror
rites.text: A simple incantation that hurls a frosty violet bolt at a foe within a short reach, stunning any animated being it strikes. The caster is left drained and must rest briefly before casting it again.

rites.name: Oriastus Corires
rites.text: A binding enchantment that softens the feelings of one human or beast toward the caster, making the target more favorably disposed to them.

rites.name: Vianostor
rites.text: A dark ritual craft that drains the vital spark from living bodies using a corpse-like frost. Its caster reaches out with bone-numbing hands to wound an enemy.

rites.name: Vialus Tausor
rites.text: A binding enchantment woven by a sorcerer that forces a target to act under the caster's will. It is cast through spoken words and a focused act of arcane craft.

rites.name: Meostia
rites.text: A conjuring rite of the third rank of arcane practice, taught to devoted followers by a withered sea-witch who dwells in a coastal harbor city. It summons shelled creatures from the deep to answer the caster's will.

rites.name: Seraullanum
rites.text: A ritual craft that lets a practitioner cast one enchantment after another without pause. It operates through the caster's inner glow, sweeping it clear between castings.

rites.name: Ceornanum Caunilum
rites.text: A shaping craft that lets its practitioner take on the hues of the land around them. Some scholars hold it to be the same art as shifting skin to match a surrounding.

rites.name: Meostollor
rites.text: A dark enchantment that binds ill fortune onto a being, dwelling, or artifact. It is cast as a harmful working meant to spread misfortune.

rites.name: Amerirnium
rites.text: A sacred rite granted to keepers of the wild who serve the green powers. It lets them calm beasts and growing things through a devoted act of worship.

rites.name: Valeostarus
rites.text: A minor incantation that novice casters learn first during their training. Its effects are slight and fleeting, usually harmless, meant to amuse young onlookers or dazzle ordinary folk.

rites.name: Rilium Riallus
rites.text: A compulsion craft that bends a creature of wild nature into loyal service for the one who casts it. It was once called by an older, cruder name.

rites.name: Valolus Reosum
rites.text: A ritual craft that calls a burst of radiant sky-light out of a chosen object. Certain temple priests of two sun-aligned orders are said to practice it.

rites.name: Oralleoses
rites.text: A ritual working lets a caster briefly amplify their sway over restless dead and arcane forces, aided by a small circle of attendant clerics. It is one of the rites bound into a sacred relic.

rites.name: Mernanum
rites.text: A withering affliction laid upon the unwary by a serpent-blooded sovereign who rules the high tableland. Its bearers slowly take on the scales and cold stillness of the reptile people.

rites.name: Tillium Solintus
rites.text: A soothing incantation that quiets strong feelings across a gathering of beings. It works by dampening the passions of many at once.

rites.name: Cistorum
rites.text: A healing rite that mends wounds more serious than minor scrapes. It is a step beyond simpler mending, drawing on the same sacred or dark currents.

rites.name: Reonosium
rites.text: A common incantation used by ritual casters in a distant eastern region. It is seldom encountered beyond that homeland.

rites.name: Corentor
rites.text: A withering incantation practiced by sorcerers who bind themselves to shadowy bargains. It draws on decay and death to harm a target.

rites.name: Telontes
rites.text: A warding enchantment that shields a being against spoken magical orders, and can turn such an order back onto the one who uttered it.

rites.name: Amaustiasia
rites.text: A minor death-touched rite that a practitioner casts to rupture the tendons of a living foe. Both secret scholars and priests of the grave may wield it.

rites.name: Solinium
rites.text: A ritual craft that calls a being of the heavens down into the mortal world. The caster invokes a celestial guardian to appear at their side.

rites.name: Veonum
rites.text: A set of enchantments taught to priests and wild-keepers, letting them sway the minds of beings that can reason. It belongs to the sacred arts of the old orders.

rites.name: Meonaror
rites.text: A sacred incantation taught to devoted servants of a death goddess. Its target becomes plagued by the restless ghosts of everyone they later slay.

rites.name: Miallanum
rites.text: A ritual craft that calls forth spirits of the wild and binds them into the forms of beasts. The summoned creatures are born from the otherworld and answer to the caster for a time.

rites.name: Teloleonium
rites.text: A minor personal charm taught to apprentice casters, which muffles the sound of the user's steps and grants nimble, quiet landings for a short span.

rites.name: Meliarum
rites.text: A group of spells granted to priests who serve gods of misfortune and deceit, and to unruly holy warriors. These spells stir disorder, mischief, and bewilderment across the world.

rites.name: Tollum
rites.text: A ritual working that calls forth a magical fire which keeps burning without ever needing fuel. Practitioners use it to light sacred spaces and enduring lamps.

rites.name: Reostianium
rites.text: A binding rite that gathers the battle force offered by willing giver souls and pours it into a single chosen fighter. The fighter's might becomes the sum of all who gave it.

rites.name: Riarnia
rites.text: A dark sleep-hex woven by a sorcerer's chant. It may be invoked only once each day, and it demands a moderate degree of skill to shape.

rites.name: Saurenia
rites.text: A sacred gift granted by devout followers of a harvest deity. It lets one nearby companion try again with improved chances after failing to withstand an assault.

rites.name: Ameolia
rites.text: A transformation working that lets casters move swiftly across a hostile otherworldly realm by reshaping their own form. It was crafted specifically for mages who journey through that dangerous dimension.

rites.name: Villeornor
rites.text: A harmless illusion hex that makes a skull appear to grin and watch its target, meant only to annoy and unsettle the one it is cast upon.

rites.name: Sauranum Ameollaurum
rites.text: A sacred craft of generosity that lets devoted healers and priests draw on divine favor to aid others. Its practitioners gain spells tied to giving and mercy.

rites.name: Corerallum
rites.text: A sacred flame ritual that a devout caster kindles to still the restless hearts of those nearby. It is shared among servants of gods who guard hearth and goodwill.

rites.name: Viarnanum
rites.text: A common incantation practiced by sorcerers and courtesans in a distant eastern realm. It is seldom encountered beyond that region's borders.

rites.name: Tianus Rilia
rites.text: A ritual craft that lets a practitioner sway the level of a body of water, drawing it down or lifting it up. It can also be reversed to undo the effect.

rites.name: Cantor Vonisor
rites.text: A dark ritual craft from the second tier of arcane lore that leaves foes exposed to harm. Wanderers of the wild were granted it, and it could also be wielded by minstrels, spellcasters, and scholars of the arcane.

rites.name: Nolarus
rites.text: A common incantation once used by the sorcerers of a distant realm to channel magical energy along a chosen path. It was widely practiced among the robed scholars of that land.

rites.name: Tirontor
rites.text: A sacred working calls a being from a windy otherworld to serve the caster. A counter-rite sends that being back to its home realm.

rites.name: Telestum Naustillus
rites.text: A ritual rite lets a temple cleric put simple yes-or-no queries to a divine patron. The answer comes back as a clear sign that the petitioner can read.

rites.name: Taria Miastiranum
rites.text: A binding incantation that lulls a crowd of folk or beasts into stillness, so the speaker can draw their focus. It is one of the charms kept within a sacred artifact of a temple order.

rites.name: Seresorium
rites.text: A minor sleight-of-hand spell taught to novice casters. It briefly turns a small creature into another kind, or a small plant-made object into a different one.

rites.name: Riserum
rites.text: A hexing craft that binds a victim to erratic cycles of sleeplessness alternating with heavy, dragging drowsiness. The affliction arrives without warning and cannot be predicted.

rites.name: Oriantus
rites.text: A chant used by wilderness wardens that splits one plain thrown stone into a whole storm of stones. The craft is taught in hidden lodges among the high pines.

rites.name: Miallores
rites.text: A binding rite of sacred command that forces a chosen foe into a single combat. The spell is woven under the authority of a higher power and cannot be refused.

rites.name: Liria Reostor
rites.text: A common enchantment used by sorcerers of a distant eastern realm lets the caster alter the hue of their skin and garments to blend into their surroundings. Elsewhere the working is rare and goes by a plainer name.

rites.name: Sarnor Monor
rites.text: A ritual invocation that summons a ghostly jaw of phantom teeth, which strikes at any being the caster chooses. It draws on the arts of calling forth and of the dead.

rites.name: Laliarnia
rites.text: A sacred protective incantation that only dedicated temple seers may invoke. It was used to shield its wielder against harm, drawing on devotion to a divine patroness.

rites.name: Amauntes
rites.text: A sacred rite that lets a devoted caster brand a creature with the mark of their faith. The branded being is singled out and shown to be under the caster's holy judgment.

rites.name: Causiria Saranum
rites.text: A protective craft that wraps a being in a whirling glow, making blows less likely to land and offering a faint chance to turn aside or send back incoming missiles and spells.

rites.name: Mialanum
rites.text: A sacred incantation granted to devoted clerics of two sky-deities, it wraps the caster in a sphere of motionless air.

rites.name: Telianor
rites.text: A sacred ward woven by devoted clerics that mends the wasting sickness caused by lack of fresh food. It draws its power from a deity who guards the faithful.

rites.name: Volirium
rites.text: A minor sorcery that a novice caster can learn, used to turn food and drink sour or hasten their rotting.

rites.name: Corestones
rites.text: A bolt of sky-fire is called down onto a foe within a short reach, and a rolling peal of thunder follows, striking again. Novice casters learn it early because it is quick to use.

rites.name: Amontum
rites.text: A minor incantation that novice casters learn early. It slices thin or soft materials with a quick hand motion.

rites.name: Tisostanum
rites.text: A sacred incantation once taught to the devoted servants of a death-bound deity. It lets a caster call forth a cold, reaping force.

rites.name: Corernostus
rites.text: A binding incantation that ensnares a chosen subject, letting its caster guide that subject's movements by sheer intent.

rites.name: Vaurniallia
rites.text: A quiet working of hidden craft that softens fierce gusts within a small area, leaving only a gentle breeze to drift through the space.

rites.name: Rausornia
rites.text: A conjured working that mends grievous bodily harm, closing deep injuries and restoring the wounded to health. It is drawn from the arcane arts of summoning.

rites.name: Nesanum
rites.text: A circle of sacred incantations entrusted to devout servants and wandering warrior-monks, empowering them to strike down their enemies. Its workings are passed among the faithful in hushed teachings.

rites.name: Nellaror
rites.text: A tranquil charm of the bending craft that lets a serpent-kin caster quiet the dread it radiates. It works only on the caster's own terror-inducing presence.

rites.name: Vesanum
rites.text: A sealing ward that smothers the light within a fixed circular zone, so that ordinary illumination cannot pierce it. It is an altering craft set into a space rather than a creature.

rites.name: Saurnasanum
rites.text: A ritual craft that calls forth small spirits of the elements to answer a caster's summons. It can bring one such spirit or several at once.

rites.name: Caunorus
rites.text: A ward-binding rite that only a sufficiently wicked and mighty priest can perform. It is a variant of a protective glyph working.

rites.name: Valestus
rites.text: A sacred invocation granted to the disordered priesthood, it strikes only those who bind themselves to rigid law. Its blow passes harmlessly through anyone who lives without fixed rule.

rites.name: Vonia
rites.text: A binding craft that lets a practitioner warm or chill the air within a small circle surrounding them. It shifts the surrounding climate to suit the caster's will.

rites.name: Seriastum Valantanum
rites.text: A chilling rite taught in an early circle of sacred practice, in which a practitioner reshapes the air so that a numbing frost spreads and bites at living flesh.

rites.name: Vasus Teosor
rites.text: A binding rite lets a caster press their own intent into a beast, guiding its movements from within the mind. It works on ordinary creatures and on those grown to enormous size alike.

rites.name: Coristium Telasianor
rites.text: A dreadful, one-of-a-kind incantation that absorbs the abilities of its victim into the caster. It is a craft reserved for the most feared arcane orders.

rites.name: Nolles Lonus
rites.text: A ritual working that transforms carefully readied rocks into counterfeit lithic tokens. The rite turns prepared stone into imitations of the true tokens.

rites.name: Telarnestor
rites.text: A calling that lets a caster drive a creature into panicked flight away from them. An older reversed form steadies the nerve and bolsters the courage of those who receive it.

rites.name: Amalanum Ceornostes
rites.text: A binding ritual once wielded by devout keepers of a temple faith, which causes injuries to refuse to close and keep weeping.

rites.name: Amoreollus
rites.text: A binding craft that grants its practitioner partial command over the restless dead. Its hold over the risen is limited and never absolute.

rites.name: Ameollus Seraurnanus
rites.text: A small rite that acolytes and wild keepers learn as a simple prayer. It restores a trace of vitality to scrapes and bruises, the faintest healing one can still notice.

rites.name: Tiantanor
rites.text: A divine sphere of shadow that grants holy casters access to spells and powers tied to the night. It lets devout practitioners call upon the hidden and the unseen.

rites.name: Rornia
rites.text: A sacred invocation that calls beings of living flame from their home realm to aid the speaker. A counter-rite exists that sends those flames back to where they came from.

rites.name: Oreonor
rites.text: A binding charm that drives a single creature into an unrelenting urge to tidy, sort, and arrange everything around it into perfect logical order.

rites.name: Nalleosia
rites.text: A ritual working of restoration that mends grievous bodily harm, drawing on either summoned vitality or the arts of the dead. It closes wounds that would otherwise prove fatal to the one who bears them.

rites.name: Oralia Maullanum
rites.text: A sacred ward that lifts the harm of sicknesses which strike the mind. It draws the afflictions out of the afflicted and leaves their thoughts clear again.

rites.name: Mianteranum
rites.text: A common enchantment that throws several targets into severe confusion, leaving them badly disoriented. Practitioners once knew it under an older, cruder name.

rites.name: Coriantum Oronor
rites.text: A rare sung working of arcane power that strengthens those on the caster's side while weakening their opponents. It belongs to the craft of enchantment.

rites.name: Maulistum
rites.text: A divine sphere of unruly power that lets holy casters draw on wild, unpredictable magic. It was once granted to priests and their chaotic spells.

rites.name: Ciantarum
rites.text: A tongue of dread that few dare to learn, whose words corrupt the mind of any listener. Outsiders of malice speak it, and those who know it treat its words with great caution.

rites.name: Sereles Tausarnium
rites.text: A branch of enchantment that alters how a target regards the one who casts it. Its workings usually make the subject see the caster as a trusted companion.

rites.name: Sellaurnia
rites.text: A ritual in which a caster reaches across the veil and links their own mind to a distant, powerful intelligence to seek hidden knowledge.

rites.name: Leornium
rites.text: A ward-craft that smooths a stretch of rough, violent water into a placid surface. Its counter-craft does the opposite, raising tall swells out of otherwise quiet sea.

rites.name: Teleonintor
rites.text: A binding hex that strips a caster's grasp of certain incantations, leaving them unable to comprehend those workings. A counter-rite can restore the lost understanding to the afflicted caster.

rites.name: Sellia
rites.text: A binding craft that strikes a chosen foe with a bolt of storm-fire, which then leaps onward to strike other nearby figures in turn.

rites.name: Nausor
rites.text: A sacred invocation that calls a being of the watery realm to aid the caster. A counter-rite sends that being back to its home waters.

rites.name: Corilontor
rites.text: A soothing incantation once used by singers and sorcerers to lull several creatures into a restful slumber.

rites.name: Masteonium
rites.text: A ritual working that calls up a violent whirlwind, hurling foes away from the caster. It is taught within the mystic schools of the old temples.

rites.name: Orillia Neorallium
rites.text: A sacred chant that quiets wild creatures and beasts, including those of magical nature. It works by bending their will toward stillness, and is taught among the temple orders.

rites.name: Coriantes Corelarnia
rites.text: A binding craft that wraps a chosen space in lasting gloom, so that ordinary daylight cannot pierce it. Its opposite works the same way but fills the space with unending radiance.

rites.name: Valentiasus
rites.text: A gentle working that knits together small injuries in a living body. Its practitioners once called it a lesser mending, and later knew it by a plainer name.

rites.name: Orenor
rites.text: A ritual of conjuration that hurls a volley of glowing enchanted darts at enemies. Practitioners of the old schools use it to strike down foes from a distance.

rites.name: Amellornium
rites.text: A quieting rite that lets winged beasts suppress the dread they naturally radiate. Robed ritualists of distant eastern lands practice a rarer form of it, seldom taught beyond their own borders.

rites.name: Nauranum
rites.text: A rare hex woven by dark sorcerers that binds a victim to a temporary beastly transformation. Wicked casters use it to bring ruin upon their foes.

rites.name: Ceror Meornus
rites.text: A sacred discipline of heavenly magic that lets its practitioners wield starlit workings. Priests of the old orders passed it down as a gift from the heights.

rites.name: Valenum Velanum
rites.text: A sacred discipline of restraint that grants devoted caster-priests spells and powers tied to purity of desire. It is drawn from the faith's inner orders and channeled through their vows.

rites.name: Amosia Selaunanum
rites.text: A sacred working performed by holy caretakers and oath-bound guardians to carry a binding, divinely touched observance. It channels arcane devotion through the words and gestures of the rite.

rites.name: Niarnor Selanum
rites.text: A shaping rite that casters of both mystic and holy traditions use to fix a lasting glow of bright daylight over a chosen space. Its opposite rite summons a lasting absence of any light.

rites.name: Canellor
rites.text: A caster's spell that hurls a flash of shifting, many-hued light at a foe. The harm it deals is unpredictable, changing from one strike to the next.

rites.name: Veosanum Rallirnes
rites.text: A binding craft that lets a caster shift another living creature across a stretch of open space. It bends the air and distance around the target so they arrive somewhere far away in an instant.

rites.name: Ranum
rites.text: A warding rite that shields the one who speaks it from both ordinary frost and enchanted chill. It is cast as a binding of protective will against the cold.

rites.name: Sinum Telausiria
rites.text: A divining rite that lets a caster sense minds working through inner power. It reveals beings and workings of that gift to the one who performs it.

rites.name: Corenolium
rites.text: A quiet working of the dead-arts that lifts weariness and exhaustion from the one it touches. The craft restores a worn body's vigor.

rites.name: Meolor Amesornium
rites.text: A sacred ward taught to devoted clerics of a storm-sworn order, letting them weave a shield of pure force from the air. It is a rite of altering the world's workings for protection.

rites.name: Meosum Serornium
rites.text: A sacred enchantment drawn from the realm of thought lets a caster persuade their own mind that certain objects or beings are not there at all.

rites.name: Tantum Teleostum
rites.text: A grave-craft rite that shapes nine slender darts from bone. The rite draws on the dead to form these thin missiles.

rites.name: Corerus Risarus
rites.text: A divining craft that reveals concealed passages within a short reach of the practitioner. It lets the user sense doorways hidden behind stone or wall.

rites.name: Oraustum
rites.text: A sacred invocation granted by a deity to elite clerics, allowing them to counter a dreaded arcane doom. The power is withheld from all but the most loyal and distinguished servants.

rites.name: Reolus Nantia
rites.text: A sealing rite of warding magic that banishes an otherworldly being back to the realm it came from. Priests wield it to turn away intruders from beyond the veil.

rites.name: Neosollanum
rites.text: A sacred ritual performed by temple clergy that binds the dead into a dancing servitude, letting the faithful overpower their enemies.

rites.name: Telirornes
rites.text: A withering ritual drawn from the dark arts that lets a caster wither a broad stretch of plant life at once. It stands among the strong spells of its arcane tradition.

rites.name: Sintellum
rites.text: A divining rite reveals the sinister presence clinging to objects or beings. Some forms can be turned around to sense the opposite, a gentle radiance instead of a dark one.

rites.name: Coronteria
rites.text: A tainting rite that poisons a great store of provisions so that everyone who eats from it turns bitterly against the people sharing their table.

rites.name: Leornes Corontalium
rites.text: A sorcerous enchantment that clouds the mind of a living creature, leaving it stunned and unable to act for a short while.

rites.name: Coriarellia
rites.text: A sigil-inscribed hand mark wielded by sacred earth-readers, said to be the strongest of its kind, able to slay an opponent at once.

rites.name: Valentinus
rites.text: A dark ritual that transforms a bearer's limb into a black arachnid. It draws on death-magic and reshapes flesh into something that crawls.

rites.name: Telintes Telorum
rites.text: A carved sigil of old binding that, when inscribed upon a tool or weapon, lets its bearer strike a chosen adversary with far harsher force.

rites.name: Nosiania
rites.text: A sacred surge of storm-fury that priests of the weather-keeping orders may call upon once per rest. It lets a devoted servant unleash a violent blast of stormy force against foes.

rites.name: Rauntum Vosor
rites.text: A cross-disciplinary ritual reshapes the outward form of restless dead so they appear living and well. A simpler illusion-only version of the working is also taught.

rites.name: Ceollium
rites.text: A common incantation practiced by ritual scholars of a distant eastern realm, used to sense the presence of living beings nearby.

rites.name: Miastes
rites.text: A sacred divination rite that lets devoted caster-priests of a death-bound deity sense the breath of the still-animate. Only those who serve the grave's keeper may perform it.

rites.name: Orostanum Siarum
rites.text: A sacred discipline wielded by holy warriors who channel their faith into a sweeping surge of force that tears through foes. It is practiced by oath-bound champions of the order.

rites.name: Sillania
rites.text: A sorcerous craft that lets a practitioner sense hidden ores and buried veins within stone. Once reserved for learned casters, it spread among priests and mages of distant lands who revere earth and forge deities.

rites.name: Amosares
rites.text: A sacred hush granted to devout keepers of a shadow-patron, it drifts a watcher's attention toward idle thoughts. Those under its veil are less likely to spot anything out of place nearby.

rites.name: Ceollum
rites.text: A sacred working that lifts drifting mists and haze from the air around its speaker. It is a protective art taught to mages who must see clearly through damp and gloom.

rites.name: Neontium Seonaulum
rites.text: A ritual working taught only to devoted keepers of a death-god's rites, it hastens the wearing away of any object touched by it. Living flesh remains untouched by its effect.

rites.name: Vanteolium
rites.text: A ward-working once practiced by priestly keepers of a sun-lord. It lets a caster shrug off the dragging weight of sorrow and fear.

rites.name: Laurnum Seosentium
rites.text: A craft of bending luminous energy into a focused beam that strikes a single foe. The strike wounds its target and can leave it briefly blinded, favored by practitioners who channel raw, unpredictable forces.

rites.name: Amastolles
rites.text: A mental mantle that lets seers and minds of the sacred draw on the final stillness of living things. Its gifts shape grey withering force and summon the restless dead.

rites.name: Oreolanum Telaustinum
rites.text: A binding ward that holds a creature fast against any shift into other realms. It works by locking the traveler's passage through the hidden folds of space.

rites.name: Telornia Nosanum
rites.text: A sorcerous working that drops the air of a zone to bitter cold for many hours at once. It harms cold-sensitive beings and numbs wearers of mail, and a ritual can bind the chill to remain forever.

rites.name: Vontiasus
rites.text: A ritual working that summons burning coils from the earth to seize and scorch any creature nearby. It was devised by a fire-wielding scholar from a distant realm.

rites.name: Veornostes
rites.text: A divining art that reveals the presence of objects or beings carrying an unruly, turbulent aura. Practitioners use it to learn what kind of disorder hides within a thing.

rites.name: Oriantus Maunus
rites.text: A stronger form of rest that settles over more beings and over sturdier ones alike. It reaches deeper than ordinary sleep and holds creatures far longer.

rites.name: Carnostia
rites.text: A lethal evocation craft that hurls scorching infernal fire from a distant abyssal wellspring straight into chosen targets. It is taught among the higher ranks of arcane practitioners.

rites.name: Coroneores
rites.text: A sacred rite of the faith of the grave, performed by its clergy to channel divine power. It is a prayer-spell that only the ordained servants of the death-god may learn and cast.

rites.name: Teontaulia
rites.text: An ancient divining art by which a caster reads the stray inner musings of nearby minds. It was first shaped by a reclusive order of sorcerers who guarded its secrets closely.

rites.name: Seronum
rites.text: A slight enchantment that a novice of the illusory arts can learn to master. It lets the caster dim a chosen light source or soften the glow across a small space.

rites.name: Lasia
rites.text: A sacred divining rite that warns the caster when a dark-skinned underground folk nearby are present. It is drawn from the seeing sphere of the temple orders.

rites.name: Leontes Tontum
rites.text: A great levitation working that lifts many bodies into the air at once. It was devised by a renowned sorcerer who shaped its arcane pattern.

rites.name: Valaustilia
rites.text: A mind-guarding ward practiced by sacred keepers of a hidden sanctum, used to turn aside unseen thought-intrusions. It belongs to the devout orders who serve the deep halls.

rites.name: Ameoranum
rites.text: A ritual working grants the caster a sight that pierces the veil of the unseen. Those who wield it perceive hidden powers that ordinary eyes cannot.

rites.name: Larnialium
rites.text: A ritual chant that temple guardians speak to unleash a crushing blast of noise. It is taught to holy warriors who serve a stern deity of iron.

rites.name: Veres
rites.text: A flaming sphere of conjured fire can be set to erupt after a chosen delay. Its burst happens only once the timer runs out, like a fireball held in reserve.

rites.name: Rintium Siarum
rites.text: A stronger form of shadow that lingers for many days and spreads across a wide area. Secret killers of the eastern courts are known to call upon it.

rites.name: Oreostia
rites.text: A common spell used by secretive assassins that senses nearby breathing creatures. It is seldom taught beyond its distant eastern homeland.

rites.name: Naulia Rostum
rites.text: A basic incantation of the starbound seers that calls a cold, brilliant shaft of light down from above to torment a foe within reach. The beam burns harder when the target draws nearer, and the caster's endurance and skill shape how fierce it becomes.

rites.name: Veornium
rites.text: A quality that can be given to a blade. Once each day, the bearer may strike a target to unravel any enchantment clinging to it.

rites.name: Leolestum
rites.text: A dark binding craft that ties a practitioner to another living being so that wounds or mending dealt to one are shared with the other.

rites.name: Nallanum Conanum
rites.text: A counter-working that unravels ordered enchantments and bindings in the same way as its opposite, but aims at the rules-bound magic and beings of the lawful sort rather than the wicked.

rites.name: Nanes
rites.text: A divining craft that lets a practitioner feel whether a living being or a handled object carries venom or has been tainted. It is one of the rites bound into a sacred sacred-scale relic kept by an order of priests.

rites.name: Mostesor
rites.text: A minor apprentice spell that wraps a small area in thin mist, leaving every surface damp and dimming sight within it.

rites.name: Tentus
rites.text: A sacred incantation of the death-arts that fills listeners with a sense of coming ruin. It is sung by those who call upon divine powers.

rites.name: Vesanes
rites.text: A hushing incantation that was once cast against great winged serpents to weaken the fire they exhale. It works by stilling the breath of such beasts before it can scorch.

rites.name: Sirnesium
rites.text: A grave-mist conjured by learned casters in distant deserts and harbor lands. It is a cloud spell that carries lethal breath across the sands.

rites.name: Testinum
rites.text: A chant sung by smiths while they forge blackened metal into weapons and tools. Its rhythm guides the hammer strokes of the craftsfolk who sing it.

rites.name: Leolia Lintianor
rites.text: A ruinous binding art that weaves a dense web of arcane force into a dragon's vital essence. It works by threading the pattern through the creature's very lifeline.

rites.name: Oresillus
rites.text: A minor spell that briefly fogs the thoughts of a chosen humanoid foe. Practitioners file it under the compulsion branch of arcane study, and a tiny floating eye can also cloud an opponent's mind with one of its small stalks.

rites.name: Linium Seraria
rites.text: A binding incantation that drives a single bearer into a violent, uncontrollable frenzy against those nearby. Its effect falls on one person alone, pulling them toward bloodshed.

rites.name: Siarneontes
rites.text: A combined incantation that was devised as the earliest of its kind, first worked out by a single named caster who crafted it into a lethal working.

rites.name: Ciliarnes
rites.text: A ritual sight that lets a caster read how gravely each nearby wounded body is hurt. It is a quiet craft taught in temple cells, where healers judge the dying.

rites.name: Corausia Viasestanum
rites.text: A ritual working that grants its bearer a heightened way of seeing in total gloom. It reshapes the eyes so that the dark reveals its shapes to them.

rites.name: Cillia
rites.text: A ward-working that breaks enforced stillness and restores sound to a place where it has been smothered. Its sacred form is tied to a deity of song and voice.

rites.name: Amores Lirnium
rites.text: A sacred utterance of the ordered faithful that stuns, hinders, and can destroy beings who reject lawful order. It stands opposite a chaotic counter-utterance of disorder.

rites.name: Nernium Meosillia
rites.text: A transformative incantation that lets the one who speaks it grow a tail. It works by reshaping the caster's own body.

rites.name: Serintanum Reostiallia
rites.text: A rare binding craft from the southern schools that reshapes harm, turning the injury done to a caster back toward its source. It belongs to the old tradition of altering magic.

rites.name: Amarninum
rites.text: A dire incantation that draws the water from living bodies by weaving together the arts of transformation and death. Devout flame-keepers of a sun-scorched realm wield it as a common weapon.

rites.name: Teorontes
rites.text: A woven arcane lattice that a fallen spider-deity once tried to knit so she could seize control of all sorcery after another deity's death. Its threads were meant to bind magic under her single will.

rites.name: Reolanum Nintausia
rites.text: A common alteration craft from the southern tradition of arcane practice. It heightens the force of a caster's attacking spells.

rites.name: Valeonalor
rites.text: A spoken incantation in which a caster voices a word charged with the force of the earliest making. Its utterance calls forth an effect drawn from that primal source.

rites.name: Siastia Ciallum
rites.text: A ritual rhythm practiced by sorcerers, which calls the departed back to a hollow semblance of life. It is worked through spoken incantation and careful footwork.

rites.name: Leostanum Tornaurium
rites.text: A ruinous enchantment of the highest arcane order, shaped by the most devoted spellcasters and mystic guardians who command the deepest sorcery. Only those who have mastered the final tier of spellcraft may wield its binding curse.

rites.name: Teoraunia
rites.text: A guarding rite that grants an object lasting immunity to flame. Its inventor, a practitioner from a distant mage-realm, shaped the working so the blaze cannot harm what it protects.

rites.name: Siallaunum
rites.text: A ritual working that unravels illusions cast over the land, revealing what lies hidden beneath false sights. It belongs to a single distant realm known for its fated, wondrous magic.

rites.name: Telosum
rites.text: A devout rite that draws sacred force into the caster, sharpening their body and battle skill. It can be invoked through holy or unholy channels alike.

rites.name: Seolus
rites.text: A discordant murmur is woven into the air, striking a foe with harm and sending it fleeing in panic. It belongs to the arts of enchantment.

rites.name: Tantolus
rites.text: A common incantation used by temple adepts in an eastern land, able to sense sickness in the body. It was seldom practiced beyond those distant shores.

rites.name: Riallanum
rites.text: A divining rite that reveals exactly where a chosen creature or object lies hidden. Practitioners use it to pinpoint any sought thing with precise certainty.

rites.name: Rostes Valisenor
rites.text: A reversed charm that novice casters can learn to mar surfaces with blotches, grime, dust, and scuffs. It leaves rough marks wherever it is used.

rites.name: Senium
rites.text: A hidden working that veils the true nature of its wielder from the eyes of others. It lets the practitioner wear a false self like a mask.

rites.name: Teleneontes
rites.text: A ward-craft that shields its bearer from both ordinary flame and enchanted blaze. It is cast as a protective working against burning of every origin.

rites.name: Mauror
rites.text: A sacred incantation granted to devoted clerics of joyful and warlike orders alike. It grants flawless steadiness and sharpened agility, though it compels the caster to keep moving.

rites.name: Losintia
rites.text: A ward-craft that unravels enchantments clinging to a being or object, including brewed elixirs, and disrupts the workings of arcane incantations. Its power is bound into a sacred relic kept by devoted keepers.

rites.name: Amarnelia
rites.text: A sacred blessing woven only by devoted temple keepers who serve a motherly deity. Its faithful practitioners use this faith-born art to lend aid to those in need.

rites.name: Rillum
rites.text: A divining rite that reveals the presence and nature of things radiating a kindly essence. Some forms can be turned around to sense the opposite, malign essence instead.

rites.name: Sinor Tiasum
rites.text: A sacred incantation once granted to the holy servants of a death-keeping god, letting them hold back the final passing of the living. It was a rite of the devoted clergy.

rites.name: Oreosor Coralles
rites.text: A dark working cast by stealthy wardens to thicken the gloom around them. It is rarely practiced beyond their distant eastern homeland.

rites.name: Vialleostor
rites.text: A sacred incantation that wraps the caster in a gloomy haze, sharpening their fighting skill and lending a lesser boost to wicked allies nearby. It dulls the strength of virtuous foes in the same area.

rites.name: Amornum Oreollia
rites.text: A grim ritual rite once invoked by priests of a dark temple to bind their lives together in a shared bargain with the grave. It drew strength from the devotion of its caster.

rites.name: Noraullia
rites.text: A rare grave-craft ward that wraps its caster in a dark aura, harming any creature that touches it. Only practitioners of the death-arts may weave it.

rites.name: Tentia Leostelia
rites.text: A sacred incantation that calls down holy wrath from above, striking a chosen foe with radiant judgment. It is wielded by devout casters who channel the will of their gods.

rites.name: Teleniarnum
rites.text: A divining charm that warns its wielder when unseen watchers are spying through arcane means. It sounds a silent alarm whenever another's sorcery reaches toward them.

rites.name: Serentilles
rites.text: A dark rite known only to a certain land of fate, used mainly by ghoul lords. It is cast to hold back the closing of a life.

rites.name: Teorium Seostaranum
rites.text: A sacred invocation granted only to devoted shadow-priests, hurling bolts of murk that wound and stagger a foe. A sorcerer's version of the same working also exists among scholars of the hidden arts.

rites.name: Corilium
rites.text: A ritual craft that holds a toxin dormant within a body, postponing its harm for a set span. It also lets the afflicted endure venom untouched until the working fades, buying precious time to seek a remedy.

rites.name: Serialernum
rites.text: A magical sensing craft that reveals beings whose bodies can slip between human and beast form. It works like a broader sight for shifting kin, tuned to one kind of changing blood alone.

rites.name: Amaustus Rellor
rites.text: A binding rite that sprouts leathery membrane pinions on the one who receives it. The wings let the bearer take to the night sky.

rites.name: Amiallor
rites.text: A divining rite that reveals the presence of things bearing an orderly, rightful aura. Practitioners use it to learn what they are facing and whether it follows the sanctioned bonds of the world.

rites.name: Telenium Viantia
rites.text: A sacred discipline that grants ritual casters the power to unmake matter through ruinous incantations. Its practitioners channel devastating forces drawn from a divine source.

rites.name: Neonum Amiasaunor
rites.text: A ritual working that heats a chosen zone until its air scorches the lungs. Anyone clad in iron feels the metal burn as though it were glowing in a forge.

rites.name: Amaurnesus
rites.text: A sacred transformation rite performed by devoted temple sorcerers who serve a moon-aligned deity. It reshapes the appearance of those who perform it in devotion.

rites.name: Seraulonor
rites.text: A binding craft that unravels disorder within its reach. It undoes wild, lawless workings and banishes the unstable beings that rely on them, acting as a mirror to the ward against malice.

rites.name: Rauntiastes
rites.text: A ritual working that separates a person's awareness from their flesh, leaving the body untouched and immune to harm in a frozen stillness. A counter-working can later rejoin the two and restore what was split.

rites.name: Amoreolum
rites.text: A rare enchantment that is woven into a small charm or token, granting its bearer a pair of leathery wings. It is seldom mastered by casters.

rites.name: Lireostia
rites.text: A ward-working practice used by hedge-mages in a distant eastern realm. It turns aside incoming harm, and it is seldom taught beyond those lands.

rites.name: Reonolus
rites.text: A ward-craft that shields its caster from spirits of the wild, the restless dead, and creatures from beyond the mortal realm. It is cast as a protective enchantment against such beings.

rites.name: Tirus Riallium
rites.text: A binding incantation that forces a wild creature to follow silent mental commands from its caster. It bends an animal's will to the caster's wishes.

rites.name: Valaseolium
rites.text: A chant that fills a living being's chest with air so it can hold its breath far longer than normal. Its opposite drains every breath from a foe's lungs.

rites.name: Coreoses
rites.text: A ward-chant spoken in one distant realm that gives a sounding of coming dangers beneath the surface. It is taught to initiates of the old sealed-hall orders.

rites.name: Teleolor Lestianor
rites.text: A rare death-working incantation drawn from the southern arts of the dead, long practiced by a few scholars who channel it through a single sharp strike of vital force.

rites.name: Rilanum Tistia
rites.text: A common incantation used by sorcerers in the eastern lands, which is seldom known beyond those borders. It sets a blade moving on its own through the air.

rites.name: Riliasor
rites.text: A divining rite lets a caster sense nearby beings of differing natures, such as outsiders and other creatures, within a short reach.

rites.name: Ameseolus
rites.text: A common warding incantation from the southern arcane tradition that shields its caster against the dead and the undead. Practitioners cast it often because it was easy to learn and widely taught.

rites.name: Rirnaustium
rites.text: A ritual working in which flames are coaxed into rhythmic, weaving motion by a caster's command. It was devised by an ancient order of arcane sorcerers.

rites.name: Cillerum
rites.text: A ritual rite practiced by temple keepers of a sun-favored deity, allowing them to sense blades and arms nearby. A broader folk version of the rite lets common casters perceive armaments as well.

rites.name: Caleonum
rites.text: A sacred working taught to devoted clergy of a night deity, letting them walk unhindered through complete blackness. It alters the caster's own senses so the dark poses no obstacle.

rites.name: Soniasium
rites.text: A family of altering incantations that practitioners of the arcane arts use to reshape the properties of things around them. Their casters wield these workings in deliberate, learned patterns.

rites.name: Telianus Nastauror
rites.text: A ritual rite of temple priests who call on a sacred patron of torment to conjure phantom edges that circle a wounded foe. The working reshapes how the air around a hurt body feels to it.

rites.name: Oreostor
rites.text: A ritual rite practiced by the priestly servants of a lunar deity. It lets the devout sense restless presences that linger between the living and the dead.

rites.name: Oreollesum
rites.text: A ward-enchantment that can be bound into enchanted arms. Against restless dead, it unmakes them outright.

rites.name: Amernauses
rites.text: A minor illusion craft lets a caster reshape how their own face and form appear to others. It was known in ancient times by a different, older name.

rites.name: Caullenes
rites.text: A simple incantation used by wandering singers and sylvan priests to sense where paths meet. Its casters rely on it to find the junctions where roads and fates converge.

rites.name: Amernisus
rites.text: A practiced rite lets a caster step through a seam in the air to arrive unerringly at a nearby spot, sometimes carrying companions or belongings along with them.

rites.name: Saunosia
rites.text: A refined binding craft that lets a practitioner press their own will onto as many as six living beings at once. It is an advanced form of simple commanding.

rites.name: Orantilles
rites.text: A ritual working that was once cast by the priests of a shadowed sect. It draws on dim, unlit fire to serve their dark divine patrons.

rites.name: Riantus Telintor
rites.text: A ritual working that priests and hermit-mystics perform to sense sickness hidden within a body. Practitioners use it routinely to find ailments before they spread.

rites.name: Vestoles
rites.text: A widely practiced ward that priests, wild-keepers and mystic adepts cast to sense hidden enchantments near them. Its working is copied by rival sorcerous schools and is also drawn from a sacred scale-relic of an old judge-god.

rites.name: Neostanum Corellastus
rites.text: A binding charm that carries a message across distance like a whisper, and can also slip a gentle urge into the listener's mind.

rites.name: Sarinum
rites.text: A common incantation used by ritual casters to reveal beings that hide their true forms. It is seldom found beyond the eastern lands where it was developed.

rites.name: Nelum
rites.text: A practiced working that holds back the shining of a glow so it appears only after a delay. Dreamers of an older order used it commonly.

rites.name: Visium
rites.text: A wasting sickness that spreads through the bite of hollow-eyed hounds of the grave. Its victims slowly decay and often die from the infection.

rites.name: Tisornium
rites.text: A common incantation that practitioners of false sight use to uncover deceptions. It reveals any conjured trick cast over a person, object, or place.

rites.name: Nilaunus
rites.text: A dark ritual craft that draws all moisture from a chosen target, leaving it withered and dry. It belongs to the grim arts of the dead-callers.

rites.name: Neornes
rites.text: A divination craft that senses sickness and toxins in a body or nearby. It reveals whether the trouble is a contagion, a venom, or a creature that carries it.

rites.name: Sontalus
rites.text: A dark rite that drains the fighting resolve of a chosen target, leaving them weakened in combat. Priests and witch-scholars of the old orders practiced it.

rites.name: Telinalus
rites.text: A sacred seeing rite that lets a practitioner perceive hidden binding malice within objects or living beings. A rare variant is practiced only by distant wandering seers.

rites.name: Orernisanum
rites.text: A sensing craft that reveals restless dead things lingering within a set range of the practitioner. Its earliest form could be reversed to hide those same dead from notice.

rites.name: Corilum Tollestanum
rites.text: A dark enchantment of the grave-arts that wraps a practitioner in a drifting veil drawn from the void beyond life, draining the vitality of anything nearby.

rites.name: Ameonor Orernus
rites.text: A ritual working used by temple initiates to hide their true thoughts from anyone attempting to probe their mind. It lets a practitioner pass a mental inspection unnoticed.

rites.name: Ameorus
rites.text: A ritual sensing art taught in the temples, through which a caster perceives hunting threats nearby. Practitioners of the sacred orders use it routinely.

rites.name: Siles Seolirnor
rites.text: A binding working that stops travelers from slipping between hidden planes. Anyone crossing outward finds the passage closed to them.

rites.name: Seriastanum Corastintia
rites.text: A lasting ritual mark woven by devoted clerics through a grim god's favor. It was once wielded by a secret brotherhood of the risen dead.

rites.name: Amorarnes
rites.text: A sacred rite of foresight lets a devoted caster sense hidden threats lying in wait nearby. It is granted to faithful followers of a particular deity.

rites.name: Amauror Telentor
rites.text: A set of sacred workings granted by shadowy patrons of the underworld rather than gods. Those who serve them can wield rites tied to the lower realms, the fiends that dwell there, and the layered otherworlds beyond.

rites.name: Vesteornia
rites.text: A ritual working cast by sacred scholars and arcane practitioners that conjures a scorching shaft of pale daylight. It is used to burn away darkness and harm enemies.

rites.name: Valosternes
rites.text: Power is granted to a caster when they pray to higher beings, and the caster can only channel it, never shape the underlying flow of magic. Those who wield it feel a warmth of gratitude that varies with the being who answers them.

rites.name: Amiallaurum
rites.text: A spell that hurls unseen bolts of conjured energy at an enemy. Each strike is aimed at a single foe to wound or drive them back.

rites.name: Valirnus
rites.text: A sacred binding that priests of a dark lord could lay upon a person, a geas that harms that person's body whenever the vow is broken. It might later be found among the followers of a rival faith.

rites.name: Riantaustia
rites.text: A ritual conjuration that calls forth a blazing war-carriage pulled by flame. Its keepers use it to summon the vehicle from a divine source of power.

rites.name: Telentor Selaurnanum
rites.text: A ritual invocation that calls upon a higher power to grant aid during battle. The caster beseeches a divine patron to lend strength to the fighting hand.

rites.name: Rastiantor
rites.text: A drifting incantation conjures floating glimmers that can be guided through the air by the one who cast it. The lights hover and shift wherever their caster wills.

rites.name: Nornaustus
rites.text: A devout caster's chant fills the air around them with sacred radiance that scorches foes and lets companions strike enemies caught in the glow more easily.

rites.name: Corauntes
rites.text: A ward-craft that shields its caster from hostile malice, drives back conjured fiends, and unravels charms woven by wicked casters. Its inverted form works the same against benevolent forces.

rites.name: Meorum
rites.text: A stronger incantation of the binding craft that holds the restless dead in place. It carries greater force against the animated corpses it is cast upon.

rites.name: Cases Coreontes
rites.text: A binding craft that lets several beings move in shared instinct, guarding and striking as one. Each joined being gains protection from the others' readiness.

rites.name: Rernium
rites.text: A dark sorcery of the death-binding craft that lets a caster slay a foe merely by meeting their gaze. It is taught among practitioners of grave-magic.

rites.name: Telenes
rites.text: A dark rite that ends a dying creature's last breath and draws its fading vitality into the one who performs it. The caster grows stronger from the stolen remnant of life.

rites.name: Coresor
rites.text: A ward-working that unravels the enchantments of benevolent things rather than harmful ones. It shares the same method as its counterpart, turning its force against the blessed instead of the cursed.

rites.name: Maulles Tallor
rites.text: A sacred sphere of endings that lets consecrated casters draw upon spells and powers tied to the passing of life. It was once granted to priests who served the grave.

rites.name: Serallisor
rites.text: A bound spirit of flame is called forth and tied to a chosen object so that it guards that object. The craft was devised by a fire-handed mage of a distant realm.

rites.name: Riniallum
rites.text: A sacred divining rite performed by hallowed seers who serve a grim god of death. It reveals the fated resting end awaiting a soul.

rites.name: Vausium Teleniasum
rites.text: A ritual used by priests of a veiled god to step safely over chasms and perilous gaps. A sorcerous variant is also said to be known to scholars and minstrels.

rites.name: Santornium
rites.text: A quality that can be bestowed upon enchanted arms, granting them the power to turn aside a foretold ruin. It marks such blades as ward-bearing relics.

rites.name: Valeonus
rites.text: A ritual enchantment crafted by a sorcerer of a harbor city in a past age. Its caster channels festive, boisterous magic through a gathering of celebrants.

rites.name: Sorus
rites.text: A ritual working that summons a drifting veil of phantom darkness. The shadowy haze hangs over an area and deceives whoever wanders into it.

rites.name: Siarnanum
rites.text: A innate power carried by winged reptilian beings and by many of their kin, even those with only distant bloodlines. It lets them loose a fierce, scorching exhalation drawn from within their bodies.

rites.name: Tostelia
rites.text: A rite by which a great winged serpent transforms itself into a near-divine being. The change allows it to rise above ordinary creatures and gain a godlike standing.

rites.name: Amolleorium
rites.text: A transmutation rite that turns feeling into a drinkable nectar, which the residents of a sky-high mountain consume. Devotees of a particular deity commonly perform it.

rites.name: Sosellium
rites.text: A transmuting incantation that is woven onto a shaft or quarrel so that it changes form in flight. The enchantment is laid on a single missile at the moment of casting.

rites.name: Valostiarum
rites.text: A sacred strike drawn from a devotee's oath, letting a holder channel radiant fervor into a blow against an enemy. It is taught within consecrated orders.

rites.name: Millauses
rites.text: A combat discipline passed among a dark-skinned people of the underground, where a warrior fights with a blade held in each hand. It is taught through disciplined training by their elders.

rites.name: Amastes
rites.text: A quiet enchantment that persuades onlookers they have slept soundly and feel fully refreshed, regardless of how weary they truly are.

rites.name: Corintus Caustia
rites.text: A consecrated sacred working is wielded by temple priests who serve a radiant sun-deity. It is a ritual craft that calls down fiery retribution upon enemies of the faith.

rites.name: Lernum Nasolia
rites.text: A small trick of hand that novice mages learn to draw a gathering's gaze toward one side for a few moments. The caster guides attention away from their true movements.

rites.name: Telarnes
rites.text: A ritual working drawn from the grave-arts that alters the divine order around a victim. Its binding takes hold on anyone the caster lays a hand upon.

rites.name: Valeosianor
rites.text: A ritual working that frees a chosen being for a short while from the grip of foreign enchantments. It is cast by a practitioner upon one target at a time.

rites.name: Oriarnus Serolum
rites.text: A sacred hex that binds a chosen victim beneath a dreadful sentence. It is woven through prayer and works as a ward that turns cruel fate against its target.

rites.name: Vellor
rites.text: A sacred death-rite practiced by devoted clerics of a dark deity, allowing them to raise a fallen body into a masked, armored abomination. It turns the dead into obedient war-shells.

rites.name: Lianontia
rites.text: A ward-working that shields its caster from having their enchantments unravelled by counter-magic. It keeps the sorcerer's workings intact when rival powers try to undo them.

rites.name: Miliastum
rites.text: A technique in which a creature of flame exhales its vital air to unravel enchantments cast against it. The breath severs the sorcery's hold and scatters its threads.

rites.name: Tiniaranum
rites.text: A sacred enchantment and illusion woven by specialist temple keepers who serve a celestial patron. It is performed during weighty ceremonies for ruling houses.

rites.name: Laustes Viarus
rites.text: A ritual craft practiced by scholars and seers that lets the caster take on scaly, reptilian features resembling a great winged serpent. It is passed between robed circles of learned casters.

rites.name: Riares Vaurantus
rites.text: A ritual working from the evocation arts that doubles the edge of a blade. It is cast by a trained caster to strengthen a weapon.

rites.name: Sernes Amelus
rites.text: A binding enchantment that turns the minds of a caster's foes against the companions they stand beside. Those ensnared lash out at their own friends and allies nearby.

rites.name: Amilus Teosus
rites.text: A ward-working that unravels enchantments cast upon a target. It was once used against a robed master of the arcane who held a high academic office.

rites.name: Tinolum
rites.text: A ritual inscription that can be carved into a blade to bind a lasting fatal charge into its edge. Smiths of the temple orders once applied it to weapons of war.

rites.name: Siaria Ceornonium
rites.text: A rare illusion craft that lets a caster wear a false face over the true one. Its many variants are found in distant lands and traditions, but few practitioners ever master it.

rites.name: Tenintum
rites.text: A sacred warding rite that unravels protective enchantments, performed only by a small order of devoted clerics. It works like a narrower version of common unmaking magic.

rites.name: Reosum
rites.text: A sacred divining rite that lets temple seers glimpse what is about to unfold in the days ahead. Only trained keepers of the faith may perform it.

rites.name: Oristes
rites.text: A protective ward woven by devout casters of the moon-faithful, shaping a sheltering barrier around the one who invokes it. It is practiced by sacred spellcasters and star-marked guardians of the night sky.

rites.name: Mernirus
rites.text: A minor sacred incantation that wounds the restless dead or leaves them more vulnerable to harm. Lesser caster-folk speak it briefly to weaken the animated remains of the departed.

rites.name: Nesium Valeorestes
rites.text: A binding laid upon a blade so that each cut carries a creeping wasting sickness into the wounded flesh.

rites.name: Ceraulles
rites.text: A sealing rite that only winged beasts of flame may perform. It opens a passage through which the living are carried beyond the veil.

rites.name: Oriarnum Valaustonor
rites.text: A sorcerous working that sharpens a caster's foresight, letting them glimpse hidden knowledge. It is practiced by mages who channel arcane force to reveal what lies beyond ordinary perception.

rites.name: Amarnes Santum
rites.text: A rare incantation wielded by hedge-mages of the eastern lands, it summons a rushing gust of holy air. It is seldom taught beyond its homeland.

rites.name: Taunoses
rites.text: A sacred rite granted to devoted clerics of a trade deity, letting them copy a small disk of metal. Sometimes the copies multiply further, but the caster pays for it with bodily strain.

rites.name: Telontarnes
rites.text: Dorvel-kin are casters who draw their magic straight from a sacred wellspring of the gods. Their power flows from that holy source without any intermediary.

rites.name: Lestontanum
rites.text: A dark ritual rite that withers the living and the dead alike, practiced by cult priests who serve a death-bound deity of shadow.

rites.name: Veostentum
rites.text: A devotee's gift lets them draw on the holy power of the deity they serve. Through it, the chosen wielders of an order are guided by the will of their patron.

rites.name: Mesor Vialaunia
rites.text: A dark rite in which a practitioner surrenders their own vitality to empower their strikes against foes. The sacrifice of life fuels greater destructive force for the one who performs it.

rites.name: Oranum Vausia
rites.text: A common incantation that breaks false images apart, favored by deceivers' rivals and the sages who study the wider arts of enchantment.

rites.name: Lirnum
rites.text: A sacred working that calls down celestial force to strike a chosen target. The strike is said to answer a fault, and the power is drawn from the heavens above.

rites.name: Valeolus Meontausum
rites.text: A sacred rite used by priests of a moon-bright goddess to kindle a devoted love in another. It is a ritual of the temple orders.

rites.name: Mistia Tornes
rites.text: A guarded form of carved sigil magic used by the shadow-dwelling folk to protect their holdings. It is woven into stone and metal to turn aside harm.

rites.name: Conum Amornor
rites.text: A craft of illusion that deceives those who gaze through scrying, showing them a false picture in place of what truly lies there.

rites.name: Telantum
rites.text: A sacred binding craft that lets a devoted caretaker form an enduring, unbreakable tie with a steed of their own choosing. The bond rests on a shared spirit and lasts for the rest of both lives.

rites.name: Carneoles
rites.text: A rare rite lets a caster call a fully grown fire-scaled beast to any place they choose. It is considered one of the most powerful workings of its kind.

rites.name: Viastor Sauntus
rites.text: A sacred blessing that grants a devout follower a second chance to shrug off an attack they failed to resist. It is a rite of the moon's faithful.

rites.name: Coreonanum
rites.text: A sacred working that devout keepers of the woodland deities cast to hurl a shaft of guiding light. It is used mainly by the temple priesthoods of the forest-born folk.

rites.name: Valolus Siniantium
rites.text: A guarded working of the arcane arts, drawn from the evocation discipline of one ancient folk. It conjures a shimmering edge of force that a caster can call into being.

rites.name: Reontes
rites.text: A ritual enchantment that reshapes a strike-charm so it lies dormant within a glass surface, springing as a magical snare when triggered.

rites.name: Caulanum Resarnanum
rites.text: A zealous counterstrike drawn from the middle ranks of arcane craft, where a believer's fury is turned back upon an attacker. It belongs to the third tier of spellwork and was practiced in a late age of the realm.

rites.name: Lantes Amoraustium
rites.text: A ritual working devised by a secretive order of sorcerers that siphons life force from its target. It was among the earliest such spells recorded in their archives.

rites.name: Vaulia Teleror
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that lets a practitioner touch another being and make that being feel pain far more keenly than before. It belongs to the broader art of bending the body through the mind.

rites.name: Sinanum Seralles
rites.text: A rare conjuration craft of the southern arts raises a sculpted mound of enchanted sand. The mound rises from bare ground at the caster's bidding.

rites.name: Rirum Amiaseontia
rites.text: A ritual working that priests of a dawn-bringing deity once used to produce a brief, deceptive gleam of morning light. It is cast by devout ministers of that sun-god's faith.

rites.name: Leorniantes
rites.text: A ritual craft in which a caster rewrites their own body to become a great scaled serpent, gaining every strength and ability of that beast. It is sometimes grouped with broader body-changing workings.

rites.name: Cinus Lerneontes
rites.text: A transmutation working that greatly sharpens the vision of whoever it is cast upon. It reshapes the eyes so the bearer sees far more clearly than before.

rites.name: Tintes Sostia
rites.text: A transmutation working that turns raw matter into finished goods or shaped forms. Practitioners of old devised it as a means of crafting objects directly from unworked stuff.

rites.name: Lausiastum
rites.text: A divine death-craft available only to priests of a deceiving lord of falsehoods. It hurls a beam of draining dark energy at a chosen foe.

rites.name: Amaurnia Orintaurum
rites.text: A common enchantment practiced by sorcerers of a distant eastern land, rarely found beyond its borders.

rites.name: Leostia Maures
rites.text: A ritual sending of the mind into sleeping visions, practiced by ritual casters. It is almost unknown beyond the eastern lands where it was first learned.

rites.name: Coroles
rites.text: A binding craft used by casters to change living bodies and objects into clear, brittle crystal. A counter-rite reverses the transformation, restoring what was altered.

rites.name: Vilium
rites.text: A high arcane incantation once cast by a skilled spellweaver to briefly bestow upon them the might of a great winged serpent. Its power fades after a short span.

rites.name: Amarnaulles
rites.text: A bond-craft that scaled beings once wielded to channel their inner power. Its binding relied on a sworn exchange, granting the one who holds it a measure of ancient strength.

rites.name: Teleontium Riania
rites.text: A sacred rite performed by ritual keepers that grants a lasting gift of flight to the people they bless. It belongs to the old temple traditions of the world.

rites.name: Mauror Telaustanum
rites.text: A minor sorcery that lets a practitioner speak with unseen spirits to bring about small, subtle changes in the world around them.

rites.name: Laleosum
rites.text: A common illusion craft used by stealthy operatives to escape those chasing them. It is very rare outside the eastern lands where it was born.

rites.name: Serintor Seres
rites.text: A ritual working that draws its practitioner and a handful of companions into a distant realm lying beyond the ordinary world. It is cast by speaking a sealed incantation over a veil of shimmering cloth.

rites.name: Mestus Siallanum
rites.text: A craft that loosens the speech of a creature dulled by drink, drugs, or sleep, so words spill out unwillingly. It was devised by a sorcerer and recorded in his private book of spells.

rites.name: Lastanum Vasteolia
rites.text: A ritual craft that conjures a spectral limb answering to its caster's will. The limb can be shaped and directed at a distance from the body.

rites.name: Valeonium Launtus
rites.text: A sorcerous working drawn from the arts of reshaping and conjuring. It lets its caster bend ordinary matter and call forth raw force.

rites.name: Nauses Teonor
rites.text: A sacred divining ritual that senses hidden folds of space tucked beyond ordinary reach. It reveals whether any such pocket lies nearby.

rites.name: Vostesor
rites.text: A first-tier evocation technique practiced by spirit-kin, drawing hidden air into the lungs to stir a faint conjured force. Its use is a common early lesson for those who study the shaping of wind and breath.

rites.name: Linanum Seolaunanum
rites.text: A devout practitioner channels a divine power through their own body, becoming a conduit for their patron deity and shining with radiant light. The rite is drawn from a sacred artifact kept by an order of faithful.

rites.name: Reoselanum
rites.text: A common illusion craft used by shadow-walkers, which blurs the features of the one who casts it. The craft is seldom found beyond a distant eastern realm.

rites.name: Sastium Montus
rites.text: A caster encloses a target within a drifting sphere of force that holds them in a dreamy suspension. Once each day the caster may question the captive, unless a protective ward blocks the attempt.

rites.name: Corinia
rites.text: A sacred domain that grants divine casters the shadowed spell powers of the underdark folk. Priests who hold it may call upon those hidden magics through their faith.

rites.name: Serastium
rites.text: A sacred invocation performed only by devoted temple specialists who serve a sky-deity, calling down a burning gaze. Its use is restricted to a single order of consecrated priests.

rites.name: Mauria Meontes
rites.text: A small arcane discharge that novice casters once drew upon when their reserves were still thin. It is a modest working suited to those who have not yet gathered great strength.

rites.name: Viarum
rites.text: A guarding incantation used by sorcerers to slow a foe and blunt the force of their strikes. It draws on the decay of order to hinder an attacker.

rites.name: Ciasus Mistus
rites.text: A sacred ward that weakens every enchantment cast within its borders, leaving only devotional power unhindered. Its effect spreads across a chosen space, dimming outside workings.

rites.name: Telirnus Serantorus
rites.text: A binding craft that fuses two separate creatures into a single new being. The joined creature is counted among a special lineage of mixed beings.

rites.name: Corinia Ciasillanum
rites.text: A sacred rite in which a trained caster sharpens the sight of a group member by drawing on a shared spirit. The practice grants the recipient keener eyesight.

rites.name: Saurnium
rites.text: A sealed ward of hidden sorcery that wraps its user in a shell of guarding runes. It turns aside both enchantments and the spells cast against the one who holds it.

rites.name: Tanes
rites.text: A ritual working once taught to the devoted clergy of a sea-bound deity. Only those who served a single god in holy orders could draw upon it.

rites.name: Rialum
rites.text: A sacred observance practiced by mystic keepers to sharpen the inner sight of their kin. It was performed to heighten the perception of those who undertook it.

rites.name: Nalernor
rites.text: A sheltering rite practiced by nature-keepers that summons woodland spirits to guard a chosen stretch of land against intruders and harm.

rites.name: Teleornenia
rites.text: A silent hand-signing code used by a secretive dark-dwelling people to pass messages without any spoken sound. It serves as a discreet way to communicate in stealth and secrecy.

rites.name: Rarnum Laurnor
rites.text: A soothing incantation practiced by ritual casters, which lulls small flying swarms into stillness. It is seldom known beyond its homeland.

rites.name: Maustes Valeoliarus
rites.text: A chilling incantation drawn from the ways of ray-casting frost, favored by mages who wield the blood of great serpents. It hurls a cold beam that freezes what it strikes.

rites.name: Seosia Telaranum
rites.text: A lens-based incantation from the twin arts of reshaping and summoning. It was once cast by practitioners of those disciplines.

rites.name: Veontornum
rites.text: A rare incantation once cast by sorcerers in a distant sea-bordered land. It lets the caster kindle a flicker of light through the eyes.

rites.name: Sauntus Colus
rites.text: An arcane evocation that refines an older protective ward into a stronger barrier. It is a more advanced version of the basic shield working.

rites.name: Reonium
rites.text: A breath-working that lets great winged serpents exhale against spirits and beings of the unseen realm beyond the veil. Its force reaches creatures that lack solid bodies.

rites.name: Corerines
rites.text: A ward-working that lays a hardened, scale-like skin over whoever the caster touches. It guards the bearer against harm while the shell holds.

rites.name: Vaurnes
rites.text: A hushed incantation that bends the mind of a listener with fear. It belongs to the arcane practice of a distant, fate-bound land.

rites.name: Lialor
rites.text: A sacred rite used by devoted scribe-priests to produce exact copies of written inscriptions. It works through a divine shaping and a summoning of script.

rites.name: Veostosia
rites.text: A tomb-scholar's ritual that lends the practitioner a fleeting surge of vitality beyond their ordinary bodily strength. The borrowed vigor fades once the working ends.

rites.name: Narianum
rites.text: A sung enchantment taught to wandering minstrels that keeps wicked beasts from striking while the singers work. A devout circle of performers was gifted this melody by their divine patron.

rites.name: Valonia Siastonium
rites.text: A sacred warding craft that shields a chosen area from scaled winged beasts, living or risen from death. No great serpent may cross its boundary while it holds.

rites.name: Riallus Reornum
rites.text: A shaping illusion that reaches into a sleeper's mind and molds the visions they dream. Mostly practiced as arcane magic, though certain devout priests of rival deities also wield it.

rites.name: Senor
rites.text: A sacred dreaming art practiced by mystics who send their awareness loose from the body to perceive distant things. Some priests of rival deities also draw upon it for their own visions.

rites.name: Ceosor Manor
rites.text: A sacred discipline of sleep-borne sight that lets devoted ritual-keepers draw on spells and gifts tied to dreams and the workings of the mind.

rites.name: Rentum Seolasor
rites.text: A ritual working that was first devised by an ancient order of spellcasters. It drains the life and power from whatever it is cast upon.

rites.name: Ceornes Lestes
rites.text: A sacred ward woven by devout hands that shields its bearer from both blade and sorcery. It draws its strength from belief and guards against harm of every kind.

rites.name: Cinauntor
rites.text: A common incantation practiced by sorcerers across the continent and by scholars in the eastern lands. It bends space into two folded planes.

rites.name: Amirnus
rites.text: A sacred ritual craft drawn from the dead, practised by devoted caretakers of the grove goddess. It has two separate effects on the living land and its people.

rites.name: Serilum Nollesus
rites.text: A contagious enchanted wasting that slowly breaks down a living body's flesh. It spreads through the simple touch of a sufferer, carrying a grim inheritance of the older withering that dead bodies themselves pass on.

rites.name: Oriania
rites.text: A battle incantation that hurls a streaming jet of flame shaped like a charging rider's spear. Scholars of the old orders teach it as a cavalry-style strike.

rites.name: Sorneorus
rites.text: Devout keepers of a sky-spirit use this consecrated charm to lodge a single haunting refrain in the minds of others, until they cannot stop humming it.

rites.name: Cialles Tostelus
rites.text: A guardian discipline that lets its practitioner take on the great stature of an ash-grove tree and call down a single bolt of sky-fire once per day.

rites.name: Seosiallia Sausium
rites.text: A caster conjures a small blade of toxic vapor and hurls it at a foe, its lethality shaped by inner presence and sometimes stretched in reach by sharp learning. Recasting requires a brief pause of a few minutes.

rites.name: Caullia Nalia
rites.text: A sacred incantation used by devoted caller-priests to summon the aid of beasts. It draws woodland creatures to answer the summoner's call.

rites.name: Corauniarus
rites.text: A guardian shape adopted by sentinels of the deep shadows, letting them draw on the innate strength of a burrowing stone beast. Its wearers keep watch over the hidden underground depths.

rites.name: Veonium
rites.text: A ritual working lets a caster step into a large blaze and emerge from a different blaze elsewhere. It bends the warmth of flame into a path between hearths.

rites.name: Seralanum Mintaunum
rites.text: A rare incantation that transforms a living body into a solid statue of precious metal. It is seldom cast because few practitioners master its binding.

rites.name: Valaunostia
rites.text: A sacred blessing granted by a forest deity to chosen devotees through their faith. It grants a brief surge of swift movement and steady footing over any ground, mirroring a holy deer's gift.

rites.name: Tilornia
rites.text: A practiced art of altering matter that lets novice casters brew a liquid able to catch fire. It belongs to the alchemical branch of their craft.

rites.name: Amauria Seriallum
rites.text: A sacred sphere of heat and flame that lets devoted casters draw burning magic from their faith. It empowers holy practitioners with spells of ember and blaze.

rites.name: Corintia Amesarus
rites.text: A wandering sorcerer's rite that bends ordinary speech into strange, unpredictable effects. Practitioners of untamed sorcery cast it to alter the workings of language and magic.
