rites.name: Caustilor
rites.text: A widely known incantation that only great winged serpents are able to weave. It instills dread into a chosen target and keeps their attention fixed on the caster.

rites.name: Siarus Amaunes
rites.text: A binding rite that summons a spirit and ties it to a caster, taking on the shape of a loyal companion. The bond lets the spirit serve its keeper as a helper.

rites.name: Marellum
rites.text: A novice warden channels a binding pulse through a weapon strike, sending rigid glowing tethers into a foe's flesh and anchoring it to the stone for a moment. The effort drains the caster, who must pause briefly before weaving it again.

rites.name: Raustum
rites.text: A sacred rite that calls down a column of holy fire upon a chosen foe. The flames strike with divine force and burn the target.

rites.name: Amialeorus
rites.text: A transforming art that lets a practitioner take on the form and some of the powers of a demon from a distant realm beyond the world.

rites.name: Lastum
rites.text: A ritual art once practiced by hermit-mystics and sorcerer-scholars in a distant eastern realm. It was cast as an enchantment to align places and objects with the flow of unseen forces.

rites.name: Cornales
rites.text: A divine illusion that conjures a loud, clattering mechanical contraption which exists only as false appearance. The craft is credited to a deity of making and invention.

rites.name: Amianiranum Teliastum
rites.text: A conjured globe of searing fire that the caster can drift across open ground at a steady walking pace. Anyone caught too close to its unstable blaze and too slow to step clear is burned.

rites.name: Valia Caustus
rites.text: A shared incantation spoken by a crew of smiths while they work metal together. It is practiced only among one stout folk who sing to steady their strikes.

rites.name: Viarnum
rites.text: A rite that slips a caster's strike through the defenses of armor and shields of many kinds. It works by finding the weak seam where protection fails.

rites.name: Viantaulor
rites.text: A ritual sigil that lets a practitioner turn an ordinary flame into a glowing snare meant to catch the eye. It belongs to the enchanting disciplines of ceremonial magic.

rites.name: Teloniastum
rites.text: A ritual working cast by sorcerers of arid lands to sense hidden springs beneath the sand. It reveals where underground water lies for travelers.

rites.name: Naurnium Sastum
rites.text: A holy incantation granted to specialist clerics of a winter deity, it releases a spreading wedge of bitter cold and glittering ice in a fan shape. A secret scholarly variant reaches farther but covers a narrower stretch.

rites.name: Volia Teliaror
rites.text: A sacred discipline granting temple initiates powers over heat and molten substance. Its patrons teach steady perseverance and reward smiths, toolmakers, and ore-diggers who seek buried reserves and forgotten craft-secrets.

rites.name: Calum
rites.text: A grave-craft rite that kindles a hidden blaze inside any living body touched by the caster. Priests of a sworn order of law wield it to punish wrongdoers.

rites.name: Coresarnium
rites.text: A warding craft that conjures ghostly toothed jaws over a chosen spot. The jaws snap shut on any marked being that crosses the ground or touches a designated token.

rites.name: Serornanum
rites.text: A sorcerous rite lets a caster touch a living being and sink it into a stillness that mimics death. The hush lasts only a while before the being wakes again.

rites.name: Teleones Serontes
rites.text: A guardian discipline lets a practitioner take on the tough, bending resilience of a riverside tree. It can be invoked once per day.

rites.name: Amasium Castium
rites.text: A transformative incantation that sets a set number of shafts alight or shapes streams of burning light that the caster steers toward a chosen target.

rites.name: Nallianor
rites.text: A ritual working reserved for sorcerers that calls up a flame of revealing. It can be cast only by those trained in arcane learning.

rites.name: Nirontor
rites.text: A guardian discipline lets a practitioner take on the sturdiness and stature of a great tree once per day. The stance grants its user towering strength for a time.

rites.name: Tialanium
rites.text: A quenching ward woven by careful scholars that snuffs out open flames and keeps nearby kindling from catching alight.

rites.name: Volor Teliares
rites.text: A rare, specialized fire craft that is cast either as a direct attack or set as a hidden snare. Few practitioners possess the knowledge to wield it.

rites.name: Valarum Mentiaror
rites.text: A practiced art of locating the true heart of a thing, used by spellcasters of a distant eastern realm. It is seldom taught beyond its homeland and works as a stronger form of simple aiming.

rites.name: Neornium
rites.text: A guardian bearing taken by horned champions who serve as wardens. It lets the user take the shape of a leaping stag.

rites.name: Reornastia
rites.text: A sacred rite that wakes or forces open a hidden threshold, letting travelers step between the mortal world and a realm of wild enchantment. Some thresholds can only be crossed once this rite is performed.

rites.name: Nenum Leolanum
rites.text: A deceptive enchantment that causes any metal to appear as shining precious gold. It works purely through illusion, changing how the metal looks rather than what it is.

rites.name: Saliantus
rites.text: A chilling enchantment that can be bound into a enchanted blade, making it bitterly cold to hold and to strike with.

rites.name: Amiaristia
rites.text: A sacred invocation that returns to the caster every wound they have endured. It draws on the gods' hand to strike back at whoever has harmed the one who calls it.

rites.name: Lausiria
rites.text: A deadly incantation in which a caster points at a chosen victim and attempts to end their life in an instant. It is feared as one of the most dangerous workings of sorcery.

rites.name: Seonium Vaullum
rites.text: A ritual working that binds flame to restoration, so that heat is drawn into the body to close wounds. Practitioners of the old orders once wove it as a rare craft.

rites.name: Miarus Valernanum
rites.text: A binding that wraps a blade in living fire, so that each stroke carries a burning sheath. The craft is taught among temple smiths.

rites.name: Reloranum
rites.text: A minor spell of the arcane arts that bursts into a dazzling flash of light. The sudden glare may blind those who witness it.

rites.name: Telosia Mialeontes
rites.text: A binding incantation cast by mages that wraps a foe in a coil of burning force. Its craft was first shaped by a wise practitioner of the old circles.

rites.name: Ristia
rites.text: Devoted keepers of a lucky goddess can invoke a sacred ward that grants one chosen person a shield of fortune. It is a rite passed down among temple initiates.

rites.name: Serelles
rites.text: A sacred rite in which skilled wind-walking priests call forth a spirit of air once they reach a set mastery. The gathering marks their growing command over the sky.

rites.name: Nellium
rites.text: A caster conjures drifting spheres of pale silver fire that circle them, pushing back darkness and exposing things concealed in the shadows.

rites.name: Carnanum
rites.text: A ritual craft used by sorcerers of the eastern lands, where burning fire falls from the heavens. The practice is seldom taught beyond its homeland.

rites.name: Leolirnium
rites.text: A caster calls forth a blade of burning light that streams from the open palm. It cuts through the air like a curved sword made of pure heat.

rites.name: Lostium Ceontaunum
rites.text: A dark sponsor who backs a caster after a bargain with a ruler of the infernal courts. In return, the caster receives hidden powers and a set of arcane workings.

rites.name: Amantia Rirnasium
rites.text: A sacred divining rite used by devoted temple keepers to sense the closest spring whose water can be safely drunk. The seeker receives the location through a quiet focused prayer.

rites.name: Valinia Lauleosor
rites.text: A cruel enchantment once shaped by a revered arcane master during his leadership of a guild of mages. After its creator passed away, the deity of magic willed that it be forgotten.

rites.name: Serialanus
rites.text: A ward-working that smothers ordinary flames and muffles enchanted blazes within a marked region. It is cast as a protective binding against burning.

rites.name: Orasum
rites.text: A common incantation once used by sorcerers, it was known to botch its own casting. Its original name reflected a clumsy mistake made by an early practitioner.

rites.name: Silum
rites.text: A cunning-enhancing art that sharpens the mind so that any task demanding wit becomes more likely to succeed. It works by reshaping the caster's thinking through a subtle transformation.

rites.name: Amintauria
rites.text: A binding incantation that shifts a creature's disposition toward the one who casts it. It works through the mind, softening feelings so the target grows warmer toward the caster.

rites.name: Sostintum
rites.text: A common incantation used by mystic practitioners in a distant eastern realm, granting the caster blazing eyes. It is seldom practiced beyond that region.

rites.name: Tenum Seostum
rites.text: A divine sphere of influence that grants sacred casters spells and powers drawn from destiny. It equips priests of a god with abilities tied to the threads of what is to come.

rites.name: Riseostium
rites.text: A rare spell of altering that belongs to the southern tradition of magic. It lets a caster change the nature of a thing by shaping its underlying pattern.

rites.name: Seolania
rites.text: A binding craft that draws the most recent memories out of a chosen mind, leaving its owner unable to recall them. Practitioners of the old orders used it to quiet painful or dangerous recollections.

rites.name: Vasor Seranes
rites.text: A sacred incantation taught to temple keepers of a sky goddess. It summons a flock of hunting raptors to assist whoever speaks it.

rites.name: Variales Nialus
rites.text: A sacred blessing rite performed by devoted clerics who reshape a difficult moment into a fortunate turn. It lets them bring a favorable outcome to pass when circumstances are most strained.

rites.name: Viasum
rites.text: A consecrated ritual that temple priests once used to call down the sight of their deity. It was practiced by the ordained servants of a single sacred power.

rites.name: Cesinor
rites.text: A practitioner gathers focus into the mind and rises into open air for a short span. Devoted servants of several divine patrons are sometimes granted this gift.

rites.name: Rarones
rites.text: A rare incantation that only the great scaled sky-beasts can invoke. It leaves a glowing burning path behind whoever or whatever is struck by its force.

rites.name: Oreoniasor
rites.text: A mage's shaping rite from the highest ring of arcane art lets a practitioner reshape a living body into a winged feline companion. It was devised by a single sorcerer in a bustling harbor city.

rites.name: Niallosus
rites.text: A bright and potent incantation that releases a sudden blaze of light, dazzling and disorienting anyone it strikes.

rites.name: Ciseoles
rites.text: A sacred binding that plants dread in one chosen soul, after which the terror spreads from that person to those nearby. It is taught as a rite of faith and a tool of the warrior orders.

rites.name: Nialium Oreollasor
rites.text: A sacred blessing is woven by devoted keepers who call upon their deity to shield seafarers while they travel over open water.

rites.name: Conausia
rites.text: A sacred transformation rite granted by a devoted order of priests, letting them take on the shape of any cat-kin. It is powerful and bestowed through divine favor.

rites.name: Telarnia
rites.text: A sacred working that grants flight-feathers to steeds, cast by temple attendants who serve a moon-bright deity. Its wielders hold a specialized devotion to that deity.

rites.name: Riarnia Teonaulium
rites.text: A sorcerous working that reshapes a lesser fire-casting technique into a more focused and refined form. It stands as an improved version of an older, simpler blaze craft.

rites.name: Teolus Selles
rites.text: A set of incantations in the mystic tradition of the dawn-priests that govern the element of heat and burning light. Practitioners study these workings as one branch of their craft.

rites.name: Coralor Laustes
rites.text: A glamour-working that sculpts a caster's living body into a false shape. Learned sorcerers of the desert regions of the east practice it.

rites.name: Rarnus
rites.text: A transmutation craft that lets a practitioner step through space from one point to another. The one who uses it vanishes in a flicker of heat and reappears nearby.

rites.name: Orastus
rites.text: A coiled incantation devised by an ancient caster race, used to unleash a violent surge of raw energy against a foe.

rites.name: Teontilor
rites.text: A rare incantation favored by temple dancers and entertainers, sometimes also wielded by sorcerous scholars. It is almost unknown beyond the eastern lands where it was born.

rites.name: Rernium Aminelles
rites.text: A spoken working conjures a small unseen hand that carries out light tasks needing neither brute force nor fine skill. Its caster guides it from a distance.

rites.name: Visum
rites.text: A practiced breath that releases a burst of bitter cold from the speaker's mouth. Priests of a winter goddess draw it from faith, while scholars of hidden lore can shape it through study.

rites.name: Telontarnes Tiseolum
rites.text: A ritual working that calls a ring of fire into shape, forming a spinning wheel of flame. Practitioners of the old arcane orders once used it as a conjured weapon.

rites.name: Sellor
rites.text: A ward that can be woven into any closable object, so that opening it without permission sets off a brief burst of flame. It blends protective sealing with a fiery blast.

rites.name: Ameontum Oriarnises
rites.text: A sacred rite grants a supplicant calm in dreadful hours, or lets a devotee surrender their vital spirit to shield another. Clergy of many shrines have adapted it under their own deities' names.

rites.name: Ameoliarnia
rites.text: A minor incantation that apprentice casters learn to briefly restore freshness to food, drink, and plant matter. Its effect lasts only a short while before fading.

rites.name: Coraunum Telisterum
rites.text: A common incantation used by sorcerers in a distant eastern land, where it releases a stream of flame from the caster's mouth. It is seldom practiced beyond that region.

rites.name: Amalenium
rites.text: A binding working that weighs down any being crossing its marked ground, leaving them drained and worn out. Its reach covers all who step inside.

rites.name: Ciaseoranum
rites.text: A ward that wraps its bearer in a living sheath of flame, burning anyone who strikes close while shielding the wearer from harm. It is a protective craft taught in old temple schools.

rites.name: Corillia Vistus
rites.text: A joint sacred rite lets one caster strengthen another caster's power to mend wounds. It works only when two devoted healers work together.

rites.name: Masus
rites.text: A practitioner's craft lets them loose two blazing beams from their gaze, one after another. Holding focus keeps the beams steady, though the caster may still act freely meanwhile.

rites.name: Celles Nauntus
rites.text: A ritual working that calls forth an unseen mass of pressing force shaped like a clenched hand. The caster directs it to strike or hold a chosen target.

rites.name: Veres Valenus
rites.text: A ritual working that calls down sheets of burning flame across a chosen area. Practitioners use it to fill a wide space with fire.

rites.name: Laurnia
rites.text: A spell that conjures a short blade made of pure burning fire, which forms in the caster's grip. It belongs to the craft of summoning and shaping flame.

rites.name: Riantostia
rites.text: A sacred rite that temple keepers of a winter goddess perform to strike a foe with bitter frost. It may also lock the victim within a shell of ice.

rites.name: Manternor
rites.text: A common incantation cast by sorcerers in the eastern lands, where it is widely known. It is seldom found beyond those borders.

rites.name: Valinor Laurnia
rites.text: A ritual working that peels the flesh away from a living being, leaving the body bared. Practitioners of old used it as a feared alteration craft.

rites.name: Cistenes
rites.text: A ward-craft that unbinds any creature held by chains, magic, or confinement. Its reversed form can be cast to bind a creature in turn.

rites.name: Valarnor Coriantium
rites.text: A dark ritual of the eighth tier that lets a doomed caster cheat death by seizing another body. It is favored by sinister practitioners of forbidden arts.

rites.name: Leria Nistium
rites.text: A binding craft that turns a living body into a silent, motionless figure of rock. Its reverse undoes the change, though the restored one may not survive the jolt, and it can be sealed into rods for use without ritual materials.

rites.name: Seraulium Mentilus
rites.text: A divining rite that lets its user sense which way a lost destination lies. Practitioners rarely perform it outside a distant eastern realm.

rites.name: Naulleores
rites.text: A sacred incantation that summons a swarm of winged creatures, used only by ordained scribe-priests who serve a god of writing and wisdom.

rites.name: Ventaustes
rites.text: A kindled rite that lets a bearer walk unharmed through ordinary flames, even those as fierce as molten rock. It can shield more than one being at a time.

rites.name: Coristor Sosiaranum
rites.text: A divining craft that lets its caster sense hidden snares and concealed triggers in the surrounding ground and walls before stepping into danger.

rites.name: Taunisia
rites.text: A flame working that wraps a caster's hands in burning heat. Only scholars of the arcane arts may perform it, and it is widely practiced across a desert realm.

rites.name: Oriarnontus
rites.text: A guardian shape that a great forest ruler takes on, letting them wield the strength of a living tree-being. It turns the ruler into a warden of the woods.

rites.name: Amenum
rites.text: A ward-craft that coils burning force into a turning ring, used by a sworn order of flame keepers to repel harm. It is taught only within their hidden circles.

rites.name: Sonanum Santernum
rites.text: A ritual gift available only to winged serpents, it lets them call a bonded companion with a human-like form. It works much like a common summoning rite.

rites.name: Telerninum
rites.text: A protective enchantment that casters weave to shield themselves and their companions from harm. It is practiced by magic users of the arcane arts.

rites.name: Valilasus
rites.text: A ritual craft that turns ordinary seeds into burning charges. A caster can ready them as hurled fire pellets or as bursting fire bombs.

rites.name: Siarenus
rites.text: A chill rite granted to devoted clerics of a winter deity. It conjures a thin, pliant lash of bitter cold that can be swung as a weapon.

rites.name: Taurnanum Rirniantum
rites.text: A disciplined stance taught to wardens that draws on the force of tempests bound within high peaks. Practitioners channel these wild storm spirits to empower their guarding.

rites.name: Cauntes
rites.text: A sacred working channeled by temple adepts who serve a lucky patron deity. It reshapes the natural order briefly so that an almost impossible deed can be accomplished.

rites.name: Oreosia
rites.text: A rare conjured working taught only to the devout of a craft-god's followers. Few among even the faithful of their homeland are able to call it forth.

rites.name: Telauntes Teloranum
rites.text: A strong attacking incantation practiced by a secretive circle of crimson-eyed sorcerers. It is preferred by the circle as a weapon of choice.

rites.name: Oraunes Tausor
rites.text: A grim incantation drawn from the death-working arts, once wielded by sorcerers and by the dread overseers of a dark cult to strip the skin from living foes.

rites.name: Nirnes
rites.text: A devotional craft that gathers the faithful's inner fervor into a lasting sacred effect. Its practitioners shape that gathered devotion into an enduring blessing that holds for a long while.

rites.name: Serarintium
rites.text: A sacred working that calls down a burning fire upon the guilty, carried out by the faithful of a far-off realm of destiny. It was known only in that single land.

rites.name: Oresteolium
rites.text: A ritual craft used by scholar-mages of a distant eastern land that grants wings of burning flame. It is seldom practiced beyond that region.

rites.name: Corerus Reoniastum
rites.text: A dark sorcerous working that the learned casters of the realm draw upon, weaving protective wards together with the force of blasts and the mastery of death.

rites.name: Tarus Tarnialus
rites.text: A bound incantation that combines a sealing ward with a swift bolt of force. Its creator devised it by joining two separate workings into one.

rites.name: Amoses Tisialum
rites.text: A class of enchanted workings that alter a caster's sway over distant matters. Practitioners of arcane arts once employed these shaping rites to reshape what lay beyond their hands.

rites.name: Amastia Toniantium
rites.text: A levitation craft practiced only by trained casters, allowing a person to rise gently from the ground. Sacred versions of the same art are also taught by priests who serve the currents of water and wandering roads.

rites.name: Lirnia Castenium
rites.text: A quiet working that slows a falling body or object until it drifts gently downward. Casters learn it early, as a simple charm against long drops.

rites.name: Rauntes Vernaulanum
rites.text: A protective working that lets a bearer walk through flame without harm. Its effect is an immunity to fire, granted to whoever is touched by the rite.

rites.name: Tonanum Oreranum
rites.text: A binding that wraps a blade in living heat, then releases it in a blast of fire upon striking a foe. Crafters of temple orders have inscribed it onto weapons.

rites.name: Meostium Neolanum
rites.text: A novice caster draws biting frost over a foe within sight, dulling their reflexes and wounding their body. The craft is taxing, so the caster must pause briefly before weaving it again.

rites.name: Valariantus
rites.text: A sacred ward that seals a chosen area against travel from other realms. It repels beings whose moral nature opposes that of the one who sets it.

rites.name: Oralum Carnum
rites.text: A chilling shroud of unnatural gloom that is called forth by spellcasters, particularly those bound to starry patrons. It is an invocation of the evocation craft, practiced widely among such casters.

rites.name: Coraullisus Oreostor
rites.text: A quiet working that chills a small ordinary flame until it can be touched without harm, while the flame gives off a brighter glow.

rites.name: Seostium
rites.text: A sacred divining rite lets its practitioner sense hostile presences nearby. It is drawn from the sphere of seeing hidden things and grants warning of looming foes.

rites.name: Teliniasor
rites.text: A temple craft that lets a caster bestow a flicker of heat upon a companion's strikes, so that each blow carries a little extra burning force.

rites.name: Mirus
rites.text: A focused art of evocation that hurls a small spark of flame toward a chosen target. Practitioners cast it to strike a single foe at range.

rites.name: Valilenes
rites.text: A common incantation practiced by robed scholars of the arcane. It is seldom found beyond the eastern lands where it was born.

rites.name: Mestes Amiarasum
rites.text: A sacred endurance rite granted by devoted cult priests, letting the faithful withstand agony far past ordinary limits. Tribal healers invoke it upon themselves and upon the members of their own clan.

rites.name: Mirneoria
rites.text: A sacred rite that reshapes a clear crystal so it can hold and carry a stored enchantment. The crystal's inner structure becomes receptive to magical charge.

rites.name: Cisaullus
rites.text: A sacred domain of the unbound will, granting the right to act as one chooses and shielding the spirit from any chain or confinement.

rites.name: Naseror
rites.text: A minor practice that novice casters can learn to change how food or drink tastes, making it more pleasing on the palate.

rites.name: Seolisium
rites.text: A minor spell taught to novice casters that conjures the phantom sound of walking feet close by. It produces only the noise of footsteps, with nothing visible.

rites.name: Norus
rites.text: An ancient incantation devised by a reclusive order of sorcerers, used to conjure a dense cloud of obscuring vapor. Its creators are said to have been the first to master the working.

rites.name: Ameolor Nollus
rites.text: A ritual rite that temple healers perform to draw nourishment from the land. It is practiced by the priests of a moon-bound sect.

rites.name: Terus
rites.text: A divining rite that reveals the most direct route between two chosen points. Its inverse scrambles a creature's sense of direction so it cannot reach any intended destination.

rites.name: Lenium Rialleontia
rites.text: A guardian stance that wardens of the blood-fury use to shield their people. It lets a protector take on an old, savage bearing for battle.

rites.name: Orelarnus
rites.text: A caster of early skill spins a ring of fire outward from their body, scorching up to three nearby beings in a short burst. It recharges after only a brief pause, and its heat grows fiercer with the caster's presence and quickness.

rites.name: Neolliasium
rites.text: A sacred incantation taught to the keepers of a river-goddess's rites. It forms an unseen barrier bound to the caster's palm that snuffs out ordinary and enchanted flames, and it can be handed to another person.

rites.name: Sereornum
rites.text: A sacred blessing that servants of the earth-mother can invoke to double the harvest of ripe crops or gathered produce. It also cleanses plants of rot and tainted growth, and it can ripen young shoots into fruit at once.

rites.name: Tanes Amiastarnus
rites.text: A chilling spell that hurls a blast of icy water at a target, numbing them to the core. Watery spirits can use a version of this power to sap the strength of their enemies.

rites.name: Ameorium
rites.text: A sacred binding enchantment that only devout spirit-keepers serving a sky deity may cast. It grants a bearer a measure of unbound choice.

rites.name: Mintia Lontanum
rites.text: A sorcerous evocation that hurls shafts of bitter cold energy at a foe, numbing and chilling whatever it strikes.

rites.name: Vanakamoma
rites.text: Vanakamoma is the concept of a sleeping power in Silenioriel, held in the Arcane Realm during the Seeding, when makers plant the Weave and quiet powers lie dormant. It is less a being than an idea waiting for the Weave to wake it, its strength measured only by what it might one day release.

rites.name: Lostirnes
rites.text: A dated entry recording that an arcanist of a fallen sky-city devises a draining incantation and names it after herself. The spell is recorded in the chronicles of its age.

rites.name: Valistelia
rites.text: A spell devised by a scholar of an ancient arcane realm, which reaches across into another plane of existence. It bears its inventor's surname as its formal name.

rites.name: Amariallor
rites.text: A mage of the fire-keeping order devises a spell that holds its burst of flame back for a short moment before releasing it. The craft is praised among the sorcerers who study such delayed magics.

rites.name: Nistum
rites.text: A dark-working craft devised by a scholar of shadow-sorcery, which conjures imitations of fallen forms from living gloom. It is recorded as the invention of a learned arcanist of a secretive realm.

rites.name: Corausanum
rites.text: A projection working lets a mage send a detached spiritual shape out of the body. The method was devised by an arcanist of an ancient realm and bears his personal name.

rites.name: Santum
rites.text: A seeing-craft that lets a practitioner peer into the unseen spirit-realm to find lost things or wandering souls. It works by gazing through a pane of drifting light.

rites.name: Valornarium
rites.text: A set of drifting, pollen-like motes that are conjured by magic rather than grown. Only a handful of skilled casters know the method for making them.

rites.name: Tiasanum Ceolles
rites.text: A dark ritual craft that draws the moisture from a creature's body until it dries and fails. It belongs to the arts of death-working.

rites.name: Serontum
rites.text: A divining art that lets a practitioner perceive things drifting in the nearby spirit realms beyond ordinary sight. It reveals unseen creatures, objects, and strange occurrences lying just out of reach.

rites.name: Noria
rites.text: A mystical working that quickens a traveler's pace through the spirit realm beyond the material world. It is classed among the shaping arts used to alter one's own form and reach.

rites.name: Corostia Raurnialia
rites.text: A protective ward drawn from the abjuration arts, once cast by mages and sentinels to guard against harm. It was a powerful defensive working passed among spellcasters and vigilant guardians.

rites.name: Coreostes
rites.text: A common incantation used by covert operatives to bring about the slow ruin of enemy works and property. It is favored by saboteurs who work unseen in the shadows of rival holds.

rites.name: Monum
rites.text: A transmutation working that briefly strengthens a creature's stamina and its capacity to endure hardship. Later, it was merged with other enhancing workings into a broader art of raising a being's abilities.

rites.name: Reostes Seralestor
rites.text: A conjured hand made of pure force that seizes and grapples a foe. Priests give it the name of their own patron, while scholars of another realm call it simply the grasp.

rites.name: Teollium
rites.text: A mental sense that lets a practitioner perceive the faint emanations surrounding every living being, object, and enchantment. Practitioners once used it to read whether something was kind or cruel.

rites.name: Amerinor
rites.text: A caster pours psychic force into a rival's skull, driving them reeling backward in agony. The working is draining, and the caster must rest briefly before attempting it again.

rites.name: Vauleosus
rites.text: A creature can perceive its surroundings as keenly as one that sees, using hearing, smell, vibration, or echo instead of sight. Such a being is never hampered by magical concealment or lightlessness.

rites.name: Valarum
rites.text: A dark incantation that can cripple or slay beings who are not wicked, and can send otherworldly visitors back to their home realms. Holy devotees wield an opposed rite that reverses its effects.

rites.name: Ceollus Nialum
rites.text: A craft that conjures a spectral hand of pressure, able to flick a foe away with a sharp crack of its fingers.

rites.name: Sallium Ameontanum
rites.text: A priestly craft that conjures a barrier of whirling, razor-edged blades of pure force. It stands as a wall that cuts apart anything forced to pass through it.

rites.name: Liarnorus
rites.text: A shaping rite that lets its caster flicker unpredictably between the solid world and a veiled realm beside it, much like a shimmering hound of the mists.

rites.name: Varnosor
rites.text: A trained blade-caster turns the surface of a steel edge into fire, making each strike burn more fiercely against an opponent's body. The flame's first strength depends on a wielder's mind, while its lasting fury depends on bodily might, and the working can be drawn only once each day.

rites.name: Tirnallium
rites.text: A potent incantation that softens the rigid skeleton of a warm-blooded beast into a trembling, gelatinous mass. Only one ancient undead drake is known to have wielded it.

rites.name: Cestia
rites.text: A mighty arcane incantation of the fifth tier that unleashes a devastating wave of thunderous noise upon foes. Only learned casters such as minstrels, wild-blooded channelers, and scholars of the craft may wield it.

rites.name: Ciallasum
rites.text: A basic evocation craft used by blade-wielders to add a burst of thunderous sound to a strike. The sound injures a foe who tries to pull away, and the craft can be used freely.

rites.name: Amantor
rites.text: A spell-craft that splits one thrown projectile into a storm of hundreds of duplicates. The casters who use it are famed for overwhelming foes with sheer numbers.

rites.name: Ceonternia
rites.text: A deep spoken formula that mends a living body from its injuries when spoken forward, and tears that same body apart completely when spoken backward.

rites.name: Serales Serillanum
rites.text: A mental technique that lets a practitioner descend from any height and touch down softly. It draws on the discipline of moving the self through space by will alone.

rites.name: Tiliaria
rites.text: A quickening charm that sharpens the caster's nimbleness, making tasks of agility and sure handling far more likely to succeed.

rites.name: Siastonium
rites.text: A dark rite that ends a living being and reduces its remains to nothing at all. An older form worked like a reversed restoration rite, turning the body to fine dust.

rites.name: Losum Cisallanum
rites.text: A mental cloak that lends gifted minds an array of inner powers drawn from the art of misleading others. It grants those who wear it abilities rooted in the philosophy of false appearance.

rites.name: Nastium
rites.text: A spell once practiced by sworn bargainers of hellish pacts in a late age of an invented realm. It is known to those who have made such infernal agreements.

rites.name: Riallia Amenor
rites.text: A quality that lets a blade be used to knock an opponent's weapon free from their grip. It belongs to the craft of arms and can be carried by any weapon that has it.

rites.name: Ristasor
rites.text: A mind-binding craft that lets its wielder reach into the thoughts of any living creature and command it. The bond is silent, passing through thought rather than speech.

rites.name: Amenaurnes
rites.text: A rare illusion craft that lets its caster wear a false, monstrous spider-like form for a short span of time. It is seldom practiced because few can master its shaping.

rites.name: Tiasor Telaunor
rites.text: A minor inner-mind discipline lets a practitioner sense when arcane forces are present nearby. It is practiced by those who attune their thoughts to the workings of enchantment.

rites.name: Orenium Lolanium
rites.text: A devotional chant that lets a cleric call down a searing radiance to wound and slow foes in battle. It was used during a later age of recovery after a great calamity.

rites.name: Sarnanum
rites.text: A thin green ray is cast from a caster's hand, dissolving a target creature or object of limited size into fine ash or dust, leaving nothing behind.

rites.name: Reostesum
rites.text: A learned hand-craft that conjures a burning fist of fire to strike at an enemy. Its inventor made it his trademark art, practiced by no one else in his lineage.

rites.name: Taules
rites.text: A cunning trick that lets a fighter outmaneuver a rival and gain a greater chance to land a blow. Practitioners favor it among thieves and wandering duelists.

rites.name: Sereostum
rites.text: A binding craft that turns back shadow-workings, letting a caster bounce darkness magic away or push through it. It can also be woven to bend hostile gloom.

rites.name: Coriastia Sarnus
rites.text: A practiced caster can exchange positions between two allied beings of similar build in an instant. Both must stand close in stature, and the working needs modest focus and can be repeated after a brief pause.

rites.name: Ameostasum
rites.text: A practitioner's craft that grants the caster command over the actions of a humanoid being. It is a quiet form of mental binding used to steer another's will.

rites.name: Neornus
rites.text: A sorcerous working that conjures a searing burst of light before the caster, dazzling onlookers. It is widely practiced by one martial sorcerer order and seldom taught beyond their borders.

rites.name: Orernium Reontor
rites.text: A mind-bound cloak of inner force that lets gifted seers and devout thinkers wield a range of ruinous mental powers drawn from the idea of unmaking things.

rites.name: Taures Silium
rites.text: A divining craft that lets a practitioner hear the passing surface thoughts of nearby minds. It was an old art of seeking and listening within the minds of others.

rites.name: Casor
rites.text: A dark ritual that comes in a sorcerous form and a sacred form. It halts the bleeding of a creature who has collapsed unconscious, keeping it from slipping away.

rites.name: Rarium Noles
rites.text: A learned inner craft that lets a practitioner saturate a zone with a draining, lifeless force. Those who master it tend to be drawn toward cruelty, and using it in the shadowed realms draws the notice of hidden powers.

rites.name: Tillenor
rites.text: A shimmering craft lets its user bend the sight of attackers so their strikes land on an illusory double. It copies a trick once possessed by a shadow-stalking hunter beast.

rites.name: Miseolor
rites.text: A collected body of spell-craft and arcane ideas drawn from ancient serpent-kin, offering a range of options and notions for practitioners who wish to channel scaled, fire-born power.

rites.name: Talles Amostarus
rites.text: A mind-bound gift that lets seekers and sacred thinkers draw on a broad power of basic natural forces. It stays whole rather than splitting into separate channels for each force.

rites.name: Orasintia
rites.text: A practitioner's stare can be turned into a harmful force that sickens or hinders whoever meets it. The power is drawn from the caster's own sight and is shared among many arcane traditions.

rites.name: Valiseonus
rites.text: Elite spellcasters draw on the faint ancient blood of great serpents within their own bodies. As they grow in power, their forms slowly take on scaled, winged features while they copy the sorcery of the mightiest beasts.

rites.name: Orintum
rites.text: Adepts who studied motion and the shape of space through the inner mind, gaining abilities to move themselves and travel between distant points.

rites.name: Tollia Niarnallium
rites.text: A caster who draws on a star-bound pact can flood one creature's mind within a short distance with paralyzing agony and dread. Victims lose heart and become easier to break by later attacks of the same kind.

rites.name: Rianeollium
rites.text: A rare enchantment that shapes shallow imitations of floating glowing gems. Cunning tricksters cast it to fool buyers into trusting hollow copies.

rites.name: Serollastum
rites.text: Practitioners infuse their own souls with raw serpentine power, drawing on a direct link to ancient scaled beings. They channel that force through chanted invocations rather than conventional spells.

rites.name: Coreostanus
rites.text: A minor incantation lets a caster briefly vanish from one spot and reappear a short distance away. It works over only modest ranges.

rites.name: Sintus
rites.text: A novice blade-caster hurls a swirling storm of heat from a weapon toward a chosen spot, scorching everything inside before it fades within moments. Casting it drains the caster, who must pause briefly before using it again.

rites.name: Reonus
rites.text: A caster releases one or more glowing spheres of raw pressure that fly from their hand toward chosen targets. Some scholars class the working as a shaping of matter rather than a pure burst of power.

rites.name: Ameolus Ceollerium
rites.text: A fiery working devised by an inventive caster long ago, it hurls a burst of flame that is gentler and weaker than a larger blast of fire.

rites.name: Teliseolia
rites.text: A fiery incantation drawn on by secret bargain-keepers who sealed dark oaths. It conjures a searing blaze that answers to the caster's will.

rites.name: Telases Vaularnium
rites.text: A dark incantation that drives those who hear it into panicked flight. It was once known by another name in an earlier era of the craft.

rites.name: Tiantanum Valialus
rites.text: A caster who draws on a bargained infernal force can harden their body and boost their vitality. The protection lasts until it is stripped away, but it can be invoked only once each day.

rites.name: Neornolium
rites.text: A cloak of inner mind-power that lets seekers and sacred thinkers wield a range of mental arts drawn from the universal idea of knowing.

rites.name: Vaurnia
rites.text: A quickly woven ward of cold power that a trained blade-caster releases the instant an opponent strikes nearby. Even a missed blow leaves the attacker chilled and hurt, though the ward can only be woven once each day.

rites.name: Sentaurnor
rites.text: A basic discipline of mind-shaping lets a practitioner summon a tiny speck of flame at will. It is the simplest working of the inner craft that bends creation itself.

rites.name: Miantesia
rites.text: A caster shapes a tiny ember and hurls it, and it bursts into a vast blaze. Careless aim can set the sphere off early or burn one's own companions.

rites.name: Valostania
rites.text: A tradition of enchantment drawn from the hidden charms within rare provisions. When such provisions are combined in exact order, they yield marvelous dishes, and its practitioners are called hearth-weavers.

rites.name: Vaunteollia
rites.text: A bright golden ray of flame is hurled at a chosen foe within a short reach. Its burning spreads to nearby bystanders and can be recast after a brief pause.

rites.name: Varninus
rites.text: A daily ward woven by blade-mages that reshapes the caster's flesh to blunt attacks of acid, lightning, flame, frost, and thunderous sound. Its protection scales with the caster's innate hardiness, and it can be invoked only once each day.

rites.name: Nintiarus
rites.text: A mystic art that lets a practitioner receive powerful forewarnings about what lies ahead. It is cast as a divining rite.

rites.name: Amestium
rites.text: A quality that lets a handheld blade drift through the air on its own. It follows only the simplest commands and can stand watch over a place, much like an animated bone guardian.

rites.name: Venalla
rites.text: Venalla is a concept of Silenioriel's Arcane Realm, born in the Fall when the first worlds cracked apart during the Sundering. It is remembered in the Shards that were left behind, and in the Pact sworn over their ruins.

rites.name: Rastirnia
rites.text: A scholar of hidden craft devises a small summoning rite that calls a loyal minor spirit to serve its maker. The rite was first known under a plainer, more personal label.

rites.name: Vaustales
rites.text: A shimmering concealment craft devised by a sly scholar of an eastern arcane city. It lets the caster's outline waver and slip from the sight of onlookers.

rites.name: Seorium
rites.text: A commander devises a feared incantation that hurls a crackling bolt of force at a target. Later generations come to call the spell by a different name.

rites.name: Seristanum
rites.text: A binding craft invented by a scholar of a hidden realm, used to cut off a target from the outside world. Its coined name reflects the inventor who first shaped it.

rites.name: Voria
rites.text: A caster's craft that calls down a corrosive downpour over a small circle of ground. The fluid eats through whatever it touches within that area.

rites.name: Malus
rites.text: A spell that lets a caster's voice carry a surge of persuasive enchantment. It draws on otherworldly fae energies, and it recharges after only a brief pause.

rites.name: Lonintium
rites.text: A mental craft that quietly turns a chosen mind away from a set deed, spot, or individual. It works through thought alone, leaving the subject sure the avoidance was their own choice.

rites.name: Amostines
rites.text: A conjured hand of pure force that seizes, halts, drives back, or crushes a foe. Priests give it the name of their patron, while some scholars among the far-off mages call it simply the grip of the realm.

rites.name: Serontesia
rites.text: A practiced mental discipline lets a user reshape one of their own limbs into a crude imitation of common fighting tools. The transformation mimics the form of familiar blades and bludgeons.

rites.name: Leostes Maurnosium
rites.text: A disciplined inner technique lets a practitioner ease the burden of their own heft through focused willpower over the body. It belongs to a wider art of shaping one's physical self.

rites.name: Telenium
rites.text: A mental discipline that freezes a target's thoughts, leaving them unable to perform any act of the mind. It belongs to the family of inner-sight arts.

rites.name: Amiastor
rites.text: A mental art that lets a chosen creature move across the ground much faster for a short while. Its effect is simple and only lasts a brief time.

rites.name: Mausteolus
rites.text: A fighter channels bitter cold into a blade so each cut freezes the flesh it opens. The frozen wound hurts the victim in proportion to the caster's mind, and keeps harming the wielder briefly afterward.

rites.name: Vosor Riantoles
rites.text: A minor inner talent lets a practitioner shift their outward appearance to merge with nearby surroundings, much like a lizard that changes its coloring to vanish against its background.

rites.name: Contausia
rites.text: A mental discipline lets a practitioner draw a weapon out of nothing and into their hands by willing it. The craft belongs to the family of mind-based movement arts.

rites.name: Volus Lilum
rites.text: A minor mental discipline lets a practitioner draw together a simple solid object out of the surrounding air and nearby matter. The shaping is limited, so only modest forms can be formed this way.

rites.name: Liasorium
rites.text: A discipline of spellcraft that is grouped by what its workings achieve rather than by a philosophical doctrine. Its practitioners bend space, time, and hidden planes to produce their results.

rites.name: Rintanum Vinaurus
rites.text: A grim craft that brings about a certain end, usually at once, though a practiced will can sometimes withstand its pull. It is feared across the realm as the surest form of ruin.

rites.name: Serontum Valernes
rites.text: A divining craft that lets a practitioner sense arcane essence flowing toward the direction they face, within a limited reach. Once a common spell, it later became a learned discipline for those attuned to magic.

rites.name: Lolaurnes
rites.text: A practitioner of blade-magic tears open a seam in reality and steps through it, trailing a booming shockwave that harms nearby foes. The rift can be opened only once in a single day.

rites.name: Visteres
rites.text: A practiced mental art that lets a caster open a shimmering passage into a separate realm. The gate is shaped by focused thought alone.

rites.name: Oriarneosia
rites.text: A craft of drawing hidden truths into view through spoken workings. Its practitioners uncover buried knowledge, read dreams, glimpse coming events, and unmask false enchantments.

rites.name: Tiasium
rites.text: A mind-born discipline lets a practitioner step through a shimmering gate into a neighboring realm. Its trained adepts use inner focus to cross between worlds.

rites.name: Aminum
rites.text: A minor craft that makes a chosen object glow so the surrounding space becomes as bright as a clear midday. It is taught among spellcasters who work with light.

rites.name: Seralles Corestia
rites.text: A mind's recollections are rewritten, either by altering what it already holds or by planting entirely new ones. The replacement is imperfect, so the person may also lose track of what came before.

rites.name: Orollantes
rites.text: A conjuration craft that brings a previously readied object to the caster's hand in an instant. Scholars of a distant realm regard it as a common technique taught in every school of the arcane.

rites.name: Misanum Rentus
rites.text: A caster conjures a fist-sized ball of bright pale light that circles a chosen target nearby, burning it with stabbing beams that stop it from moving. Its glare can also weaken the target's resistance to later attacks.

rites.name: Coriasarum
rites.text: A mental craft lets a practitioner send their body across great distances by slipping through a shared realm of sleeping visions. The traveler wakes at the far destination.

rites.name: Mirneollor
rites.text: A binding craft that shapes a cube of raw force around whatever lies inside, holding everything within it captive. Practitioners of the old art once used it to confine enemies.

rites.name: Sornauntor
rites.text: A practitioner's skin learns to hear by turning the vibrations of sound into touch. This inner craft lets the body perceive noise through its own sense of contact.

rites.name: Oreolloria
rites.text: A dark rite that grants its caster forbidden knowledge and a brief edge over rivals in ordinary or heroic deeds. The surge is intoxicating, leaving a fleeting touch of wild madness that fades quickly, and it can be invoked only once each day.

rites.name: Soria Vosernanum
rites.text: A wielder of blades channels a numbing chill into their weapon, freezing a foe's flesh and the air beside it. The foe slows for a moment, and the chill grows stronger as the wielder's own strength grows.

rites.name: Coraustes Valeorium
rites.text: A mental discipline that lets a practitioner turn the sensation of brightness into touch felt across the skin. Adherents follow it as a quiet devotion, sensing glow through the body rather than the eyes.

rites.name: Niastium Teleoserum
rites.text: A mind-craft that grants its wielder a brief flash of total foresight, letting them sense and turn aside a catastrophe that would otherwise unfold.

rites.name: Tenmavamira
rites.text: Tenmavamira is a concept in Silenioriel's Walled Age, a principle that holds that a wall is a promise kept by many hands. It was bound into the first sovereign's order to keep the groves from spreading over the roads. Its power is measured in the stone it steadies and the crossings it allows.

rites.name: Vorarkok
rites.text: Vorarkok is the concept of the warding wall, a pact-bound principle that Silenioriel's orders invoke to hold back the tides of the deep. In the Holy Age its devotees bind it into temple flame so that each stone carries a fragment of its refusal.

rites.name: Serausium
rites.text: A practitioner's mind slips free of the body and wanders a silent inner realm, carrying willing companions along with it. Scholars file this craft among the subtle arts of reshaping the self.

rites.name: Lastor
rites.text: A mental discipline that lets a practitioner reshape their own flesh so they can endure harsh and dangerous surroundings. It works by guiding the body's inner processes through focused will.

rites.name: Valausanium
rites.text: A restorative inner craft that reshapes the body's smallest living units to mend injury and steady failing flesh. It draws on the mind's control over the body's own processes.

rites.name: Raunirnia
rites.text: A small spoken charm that lets a target guard itself more skillfully. Spoken backward, it instead weakens the target's ability to defend.

rites.name: Miastaurnia
rites.text: A mental craft of the mind-force discipline that makes a chosen object burst apart violently. Practitioners use it to shatter things at will through focused thought alone.

rites.name: Tauntium Valarnores
rites.text: A bending craft that lets a practitioner crease the fabric of space so that distant places briefly press together. It is drawn from the realm of pure number and was once wielded as a sacred working.

rites.name: Lontus Mallium
rites.text: A mind-born craft that lets a practitioner swell their own body larger in any direction. Its opposing craft draws the body smaller.

rites.name: Caulor
rites.text: A mind-craft that bends the senses of a target, making them perceive things that are not there. It works through the thoughts of a practitioner who reaches into another's perception.

rites.name: Oreornum Oraunirium
rites.text: A basic mind-born art that lets a practitioner nudge small objects from a distance without touching them. It belongs to the discipline of moving matter by will alone.

rites.name: Ameostum
rites.text: A discipline of mind-born power that lets its wielder raise a protective barrier made of pure force. The barrier shields the user from harm.

rites.name: Vonteoria
rites.text: A quality that can be bound into a blade or staff, letting its holder shift body and gear a short way across space. Such a bound item radiates a strong, shimmering aura of mind-driven flesh-shaping.

rites.name: Jorurosten
rites.text: Jorurosten is a concept held in Silenioriel's Arcane Realm, describing the branching of the Three Futures as the Library shelves each possible ending. It belongs to the early Age of the first sovereign, when groves and growing kingdoms were still taking shape.

rites.name: Maulor
rites.text: Maulor is the concept of the drowned choir, a presence that hums beneath the Library's shelves and gives voice to outcomes no one chose. In the Age of Sundering it became the bond that held landfall-divided peoples together, letting their futures be read in one shared breath.
